data.name: AreaExample.adp
data.value: A co-response team enrolls so client-related notes are protected in every module that stores them.

data.name: AreaExample.ai
data.value: An administrator asks Admin Assist why a member was not paged and reviews the evidence it links to.

data.name: AreaExample.apps
data.value: Members install the Responder app, a tablet in Engine 1 runs the Unit app and a station screen shows the Big Board.

data.name: AreaExample.automation
data.value: A workflow posts new calls to a team channel, and a custom field records the fire district on each call.

data.name: AreaExample.business
data.value: An event standby is invoiced from its deployment record, and a mutual-aid claim is prepared for MARS reimbursement.

data.name: AreaExample.calls
data.value: A department adds Structure Fire and Medical call types, sets Responding and On Scene statuses and connects its county CAD email feed.

data.name: AreaExample.checklists
data.value: A daily apparatus check is scheduled for each engine, and the weekly compliance report shows any missed checks.

data.name: AreaExample.communication
data.value: An administrator creates notification rules for new calls, builds an Officers distribution list and runs a communication test before going live.

data.name: AreaExample.deployments
data.value: A strike-team deployment is recorded with its personnel, apparatus and dates.

data.name: AreaExample.inventory
data.value: Medical supplies are tracked by lot with expiry alerts, and turnout gear is issued to members.

data.name: AreaExample.knowledge
data.value: A department uploads its standard operating procedures, adds hospital and mutual-aid contacts and creates a medical dispatch protocol.

data.name: AreaExample.maintenance
data.value: A failed pump test creates a work order, and the engine stays on a safety hold until the repair is approved.

data.name: AreaExample.mapping
data.value: A department adds its stations and hospitals as points of interest and lets personnel locations expire after 60 minutes so old positions disappear.

data.name: AreaExample.people
data.value: A volunteer department creates Station 1 and Station 2 groups, invites 24 members and assigns Engineer and Firefighter roles.

data.name: AreaExample.plans
data.value: Before inviting 40 new members, an administrator confirms the plan has room or asks the managing member to change it.

data.name: AreaExample.ptt
data.value: A search team uses its team channel during a training exercise.

data.name: AreaExample.records
data.value: After each call, the officer completes an incident report from the call and a supervisor reviews it.

data.name: AreaExample.security
data.value: An administrator sets the department time zone, hides modules the department will not use, requires two-factor sign-in for administrators and adds a second administrator.

data.name: AreaExample.shifts
data.value: A career department sets up A, B and C shifts, and a volunteer department uses shift sign-ups for weekend duty crews.

data.name: AreaExample.training
data.value: EMT and Driver/Operator certification types are added with their renewal periods, and an annual refresher training is assigned to every member.

data.name: AreaExample.units
data.value: Engine 1 and Rescue 1 are added with their unit types and assigned to Station 1.

data.name: AreaValue.adp
data.value: Protects sensitive incident and personnel content, with controlled disclosure and key recovery.

data.name: AreaValue.ai
data.value: Get explanations and drafts for people to review, alongside the tools you already use.

data.name: AreaValue.apps
data.value: Most members use Resgrid through the Responder app. Getting everyone installed and signed in is what lets dispatches reach them.

data.name: AreaValue.automation
data.value: Automate repeated administrative steps and connect Resgrid to the other systems you use.

data.name: AreaValue.business
data.value: Bill for standby and contract services and prepare reimbursement claims from records you already keep.

data.name: AreaValue.calls
data.value: Consistent call types and statuses make dispatching, response tracking and reporting reliable from the first call.

data.name: AreaValue.checklists
data.value: Recorded checks show what was inspected and what was missed.

data.name: AreaValue.communication
data.value: A dispatch only helps if it reaches people. This is where you confirm members can actually be contacted.

data.name: AreaValue.deployments
data.value: Keep deployment records and cost documentation together for review and reimbursement.

data.name: AreaValue.inventory
data.value: Know what you have, where it is and what is about to expire.

data.name: AreaValue.knowledge
data.value: Members find the current procedure, preplan or phone number when they need it instead of searching email.

data.name: AreaValue.maintenance
data.value: Turn a failed check or reported defect into a tracked repair and a documented return to service.

data.name: AreaValue.mapping
data.value: A current map shows where responders and apparatus are and puts important locations in front of dispatchers.

data.name: AreaValue.people
data.value: Dispatch, notifications, permissions and reports all start from who belongs to which group, so set this up first.

data.name: AreaValue.plans
data.value: Adding members or units stops at the plan limit, so check the remaining room before a large onboarding.

data.name: AreaValue.ptt
data.value: Coordinate field teams through app-based voice channels.

data.name: AreaValue.records
data.value: Keep incident and activity records with the calls they came from, ready for review and reporting.

data.name: AreaValue.security
data.value: Sets the time zone and address everything else uses, and keeps administrative access limited and recoverable.

data.name: AreaValue.shifts
data.value: Shifts show who is on duty and can drive dispatch, so calls page the people who are actually working.

data.name: AreaValue.training
data.value: See who is qualified and whose certifications are expiring before it affects who can respond.

data.name: AreaValue.units
data.value: Units let dispatchers send the right resources and let everyone see which apparatus is available.

data.name: Diagnostic.Boundary
data.value: Run a read-only diagnostic. These checks do not send a page, change access, retry an import or release equipment. AI is not required.

data.name: Diagnostic.CallId
data.value: Call ID

data.name: Diagnostic.Cancel
data.value: Cancel

data.name: Diagnostic.Cancelled
data.value: Diagnostic cancelled. No source action was performed.

data.name: Diagnostic.Capability
data.value: Feature

data.name: Diagnostic.Changed
data.value: Evidence changed or another diagnostic is running. Run the check again and review a new support preview.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ActiveSafetyHolds
data.value: Distinct active safety holds on visible work orders for the selected unit. This diagnostic cannot release a hold or certify the absence of other restrictions.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.AutoSetStatusForShiftDispatchPersonnel
data.value: Current shift-dispatch automatic-status setting (1 means enabled). A configured rule does not prove it ran during this window.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.CapabilityAccess
data.value: Current module, feature and owning access gates were checked for this administrator. This is separate from the selected member’s action permission and session.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ChannelFailure
data.value: A send service or provider recorded a failure or decline for at least one channel attempt. This does not prove that every channel failed. Inspect the attempt and the source communication settings.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ChannelSkipped
data.value: A recorded channel attempt was skipped. The trace reason describes that decision; another route may still have sent.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.DeliveryUnknown
data.value: No authenticated delivery or acknowledgement receipt is available in this capture path. Provider acceptance must not be interpreted as receipt by a responder.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.DisabledAutoAvailable
data.value: Current automatic-availability setting (1 means disabled). The owning one-hour availability projection may affect what users see without a new status row.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EffectivePermission
data.value: The supported action was checked through its current permission policy. Resource group locks require the specific target; unsupported combinations remain unknown. Review roles and permission rows.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EnableTextToCall
data.value: Current text-to-call switch. A disabled switch can explain text intake only; it does not diagnose email, CAD or API imports.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.Entitlement
data.value: Current add-on metadata is checked separately from permissions. A denied source does not prove an add-on is missing; unavailable billing remains unknown.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EquipmentReadiness
data.value: The equipment evidence source was unavailable or restricted. Do not infer readiness from missing check or hold data.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.EquipmentRelease
data.value: Calibration, parts, assignments and the authorized return-to-service decision require the owning maintenance records. No automatic release is performed.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.FailedChecks
data.value: Recorded failed unit checks in the selected window. A later repair or completed check must be verified in the owning records.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.HistoricalTrace
data.value: Trace coverage is measured from recorded attempt sequences. Missing starts, completions, sequence gaps or dropped events leave the attempt incomplete.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ImportAcceptance
data.value: End-to-end received/parsed/imported history is not available for all intake providers. Review the owning parser and provider logs using a non-sensitive reference.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.LocalMinimum
data.value: The locally required staffing minimum and site-specific qualification policy have not been established. An empty or non-empty roster cannot certify coverage.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MaintenanceReadiness
data.value: Maintenance evidence is unavailable or restricted. Free checklist evidence is evaluated separately; missing maintenance data does not certify readiness.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MapClientScope
data.value: This check uses the v4 map policy. Tracker connectivity, other clients and historical location visibility still require their owning diagnostics.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MapMarker
data.value: The current v4 map selection policy was evaluated for this resource without returning coordinates. Review marker TTL, status location and location visibility.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.MemberActive
data.value: Current membership or assignment eligibility may block access or paging. Review disabled and removed membership on the personnel screen.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.NotSelected
data.value: The complete recorded routing attempt did not select this member. Review the call recipients, group, role, unit crew and shift routing used for that attempt.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.OverdueChecks
data.value: Expected unit checks in the selected window that remain overdue and neither completed nor skipped. Review the owning checklist before relying on the unit.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.OverdueMaintenance
data.value: Visible open work orders for this unit whose due date has passed. Inspect the maintenance record for assignment, parts and the authorized return-to-service decision.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PagingPreferences
data.value: Current dispatch preferences and verified contact flags determine the eligible SMS, email and push channels. Review the member profile; present eligibility does not prove historical delivery.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PersonnelOnUnitSetUnitStatus
data.value: Current personnel-on-unit propagation setting (1 means enabled). Review unit crew and type overrides before attributing a transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PingAge
data.value: Recorded location ping age, in minutes, is compared with the current TTL. A status location may still supply a marker after a ping expires.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PlatformTelemetry
data.value: Platform queue depth, retry state, credentials and all external success/error history are not available here. Use the owning integration history or download a reviewed support bundle.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.PushDeviceHealth
data.value: Push registration and last-seen health are not established by this trace. Review the device in the owning application and use the existing communication test deliberately.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.QualificationGaps
data.value: Members of the selected role who do not meet its recorded qualification requirements as of today. This is a count, not a disclosure of certificate or personnel content.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.QualifiedRoster
data.value: Current on-duty roster members who meet the selected role’s recorded qualification requirements, optionally limited to the selected roster group. Approved trades are resolved by the owning roster builder.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ResponseAvailability
data.value: Scheduled and qualified staff are not guaranteed responders. Confirm actual availability and concurrent commitments through the owning operations process.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.RosterOverlap
data.value: People assigned more than once across the current resolved roster. Review overlapping shifts, groups and approved trades before assuming they can cover concurrent work.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ScheduledRoleVacancies
data.value: Unfilled slots for the selected role in currently active shift schedules, optionally limited to the selected group. These schedule targets do not establish an operational staffing minimum.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.SessionFreshness
data.value: A different member’s live session claims are not supplied to this diagnostic. Use the normal sign-out/sign-in or approved session recovery flow after checking account and access policy; do not share credentials.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ShiftCallDispatchPersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Current shift-dispatch personnel status code. This is current configuration, not evidence of a past transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.ShiftCallReleasePersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Current shift-release personnel status code. This is current configuration, not evidence of a past transition.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.StatusHistory
data.value: Number of recorded status transitions in the selected window, bounded to 100. An absent row is not proof that a scheduled automation did not run.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.StatusWriterUnknown
data.value: The selected status rows do not record the transition writer. A destination-decision source must not be mislabeled as the cause of a status change.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.UnitCallDispatchStatusToSet
data.value: Current unit-dispatch status code. Unit-type overrides and the owning dispatch path must also be checked.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.UnitCallReleaseStatusToSet
data.value: Current unit-release status code. Unit-type overrides and the owning release path must also be checked.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.emailImportFailureCount
data.value: Count of configured email sources marked failed. Review the import source configuration and its owning error report; credentials and error bodies are excluded.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.emailImportSourceCount
data.value: Count of configured email import sources. Zero only identifies missing email configuration; it says nothing about other intake channels.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.failedWorkflowCount
data.value: Current failed workflow runs in the last seven days, under your workflow-run permission. This is department-wide context, not proof of the selected feature’s cause.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.importHeartbeatMissing
data.value: Compare the last recorded email poll with the expected interval in the operating profile. Missing or future poll timestamps cannot establish a healthy poller.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.overdueRecordReviewCount
data.value: Current overdue record reviews visible to you. This is administrative context, not proof of report execution failure.

data.name: Diagnostic.Check.textSourcePresent
data.value: Current presence of a text source allowlist. Presence is not proof that a particular sender matches or that its message was parsed.

data.name: FeatureSetup.pois

data.name: FeatureSetup.records

data.name: FeatureSetup.reports

data.name: FeatureSetup.responder-app

data.name: FeatureSetup.run-cards

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentSuppressStaffingInfo.EnableSupressStaffing
data.value: Enables the configured staffing-level suppression in supported notification consumers; review reachability before changing it.

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentSuppressStaffingInfo.StaffingLevelsToSupress
data.value: Existing staffing levels to suppress. A suppressed level is not proof that another channel reaches the member.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.EtaShortlistSize
data.value: Number of straight-line candidates per requirement sent for routed ETA when enabled. The owning validator caps provider work.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.IncludeStaleLocations
data.value: Permit positions beyond the configured age limit in closest-unit selection, marked stale. Review the risk of outdated positions.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.MaxLocationAgeSeconds
data.value: Exclude older unit positions from closest-unit candidates; zero removes the age limit. IncludeStaleLocations changes this behavior. A unit measured from its station (In Quarters status, or no GPS fix) never ages out.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.MaxRadiusMeters
data.value: Maximum candidate distance in meters; zero removes the radius cap. This is not a response-time or route-safety guarantee.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.MoveUpRecommendationsEnabled
data.value: Run the station coverage move-up pass after selection. Recommendations remain subject to approved local dispatch procedures.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.PersonnelMaxLocationAgeSeconds
data.value: Maximum age of personnel positions for closest-unit candidate selection; zero removes the age limit.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.RestPeriodMinutes
data.value: Deprioritize recently dispatched resources for this duration; zero disables rotation. This does not infer fatigue or medical fitness.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.UnitMinimumStaffingLevel
data.value: Minimum configured unit staffing level for recommendation eligibility; zero disables the gate. Units without defined seats pass, and run cards may override it.

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.UseRoutedEta
data.value: Re-rank shortlisted candidates using provider travel estimates. The operational path can make external provider calls; Admin Assist does not. The configured turnout times are added to each drive time.

data.name: FieldHelp.GroupDispatchScopeConfig.DepartmentWideRoleIds
data.value: Existing roles allowed department-wide dispatch views while group scoping is enabled. This changes view scope, not licensing or operational qualification.

data.name: FieldHelp.GroupDispatchScopeConfig.Enabled
data.value: Limit supported dispatch views to the member's group subtree. Department administrators and configured department-wide roles keep department-wide access.

data.name: FieldHelp.NewCallFieldPolicy.Rules
data.value: One rule per configured field: shown or hidden, optional or required. A field with no rule is shown and optional, and a stored rule hiding Dispatch Recipients (from before the lists had their own keys) hides all four lists.

data.name: FieldHelp.NewCallFieldRule.Key
data.value: The field the rule is for: address, geolocation, what3words, pluscode, destinationPoi, indoorLocation, mapPage, note, contactName, contactInfo, primaryContact, additionalContacts, externalId, incidentId, referenceId, protocols, linkedCall, dispatchPersonnel, dispatchGroups, dispatchRoles, dispatchUnits, dispatchList, checkInTimers, part2Consent, dispatchOn, pendingCall. Name, nature, priority and type have no key: they are always shown and required.

data.name: FieldHelp.NewCallFieldRule.Required
data.value: Whether a shown field must be filled in before a call is created or an edit is saved. Plus Code, Additional Contacts, Check-In Timers, Part 2 Consent, Save as Pending and the four dispatch lists can only be hidden; requiring Dispatch Recipients means at least one recipient from any list. Review imports and each client before making a field mandatory.

data.name: FieldHelp.NewCallFieldRule.Visible
data.value: Whether the field or section is on the call forms. A hidden field keeps its stored value when a call is edited. Dispatch Recipients has no setting of its own: it shows while any of the four dispatch lists does, and with all four hidden the forms offer an optional All Call instead.

data.name: FieldHelp.PersonnelListStatusOrder.StatusId
data.value: Existing personnel-status identifier whose list position is being configured.

data.name: FieldHelp.PersonnelListStatusOrder.Weight
data.value: Relative list order for this status. Confirm all configured statuses remain represented.

data.name: FieldHelp.PersonnelListStatusOrderSetting.Orders
data.value: Ordered status weights for supported personnel lists. This does not set availability or dispatch priority.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsDisclosureConfig.DefaultRedactionProfile
data.value: Default redaction profile in the owning disclosure workflow. Review the actual proposed release before approval.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsDisclosureConfig.ReleaseApproverUserId
data.value: Authorized member responsible for disclosure release approval. Selecting an approver does not grant missing permissions or protected-data access.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsDisclosureConfig.StatutoryClockDays
data.value: Configured disclosure review clock. Verify local obligations with the responsible owner; the default does not establish a legal deadline.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.IncludeYear
data.value: Include the year between the record prefix and sequence number.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.NumberAssignment
data.value: Choose when numbers are assigned for definitions using department defaults. Review existing references before changing numbering behavior.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.PerGroupSequence
data.value: Use separate station/group sequences. This changes numbering, not record visibility.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.ResetYearly
data.value: Restart record sequences each numbering year (the calendar year unless a fiscal year start is set) in the department time zone.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.SequenceWidth
data.value: Digits in the SEQ part of the number pattern, zero-padded: 4 writes 0184. 3 to 8 digits; changing it keeps each sequence's next number. Department definitions with their own numbering keep their own width.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.Floors
data.value: Raised next numbers, one per record-number sequence, for departments continuing numbers issued before Resgrid. A next number only rises, and numbers already issued always win, so a raised next number never causes a duplicate.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.Pattern
data.value: How record numbers are written for the built-in record types and incident reports, for example RUN-0153: fixed text plus the PREFIX, YYYY or YY, GROUP and SEQ tokens. PREFIX writes each record type's prefix: its default or the department's own, from "Record type prefixes". Changing the pattern never renumbers records already numbered. Until a pattern is saved, the screen shows the one the department has always used.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.Prefixes
data.value: The department's own prefix for each built-in record type and for incident reports, written by the PREFIX token in place of the default (RUN, TRN, INC and so on). A type with no prefix of its own uses its default. A new prefix starts its own sequence; numbers already issued keep their prefix, and types given the same prefix share one sequence.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingFloor.NextSequence
data.value: The lowest sequence number that sequence may issue next.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingFloor.ScopeKey
data.value: The sequence a raised next number applies to: the text the pattern renders around the sequence, with # in its place.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingFloor.SetByUserId
data.value: The administrator who raised the next number.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingFloor.SetOn
data.value: When the next number was raised (UTC).

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingPrefix.DefinitionKey
data.value: The built-in record type the prefix applies to, such as system.run or system.neris-incident.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingPrefix.Prefix
data.value: 2 to 6 upper-case letters (A-Z) or digits. A prefix that no longer validates falls back to the type's default.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionOverride.AppliesFrom
data.value: Prospective boundary for revisions eligible for the override, evaluated by the Records lifecycle.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionOverride.DefinitionKey
data.value: Stable record-definition key to which this override applies. Display names do not identify a retention policy.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionOverride.RetentionYears
data.value: Years retained under this definition override; zero means permanent. Holds and prospective policy resolution still apply.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy.DepartmentDefaultYears
data.value: Department retention for standard record classes. Zero means permanent; protected classes, prior policy and holds can retain records longer.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy.History
data.value: Prior policy versions retained by the owning lifecycle so current changes do not silently rewrite historical retention.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy.LastChangedByUserId
data.value: Recorded policy-change actor. It is not an editable retention rule and is not exposed as raw identity in this reference.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy.LastChangedOn
data.value: Policy effective timestamp used with prior policy versions. It is not the record's retention expiry date.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy.Overrides
data.value: Definition-specific prospective retention overrides. Use the Records workflow and its confirmations; Admin Assist never purges records.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicyVersion.EffectiveOn
data.value: Effective timestamp of a stored historical retention policy version.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicyVersion.Policy
data.value: Historical policy snapshot used to resolve retention for older revisions. Never edit this as an ordinary preference.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsSearchConfig.IncludeLegacyHistory
data.value: Include supported legacy personnel and unit logs in the Records search scope. Source permissions still apply.

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsSearchConfig.IndexNarrative
data.value: Include unprotected narrative in search. Advanced Data Protection enrollment withdraws narrative indexing; this preference cannot override protection.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitStatusThreshold.AlertSeconds
data.value: Seconds in this status before a higher-priority highlight; zero disables it. Highlighting does not send a page or change status.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitStatusThreshold.BaseType
data.value: Base status meaning for a threshold, independent of custom status names and colors.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitStatusThreshold.WarnSeconds
data.value: Seconds in this status before a warning highlight; zero disables it. An alert at or before this threshold makes the row alert-only.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitStatusThresholds.Thresholds
data.value: Board highlighting thresholds grouped by base status meaning. An empty list disables highlighting.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitTypeCallStatusOverride.DispatchStatus
data.value: Option of this unit type's own status set applied on dispatch, ahead of the department's dispatch status; minus one uses the department's dispatch status.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitTypeCallStatusOverride.ReleaseStatus
data.value: Option of this unit type's own status set applied on release, ahead of the department's release status; minus one uses the department's release status.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitTypeCallStatusOverride.UnitTypeId
data.value: Existing unit type receiving this override. A unit type name is not a qualification or staffing clearance.

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitTypeCallStatusOverrideSetting.Overrides
data.value: Per-unit-type dispatch and release status overrides. The owning consumer resolves these before department defaults.

data.name: Impact.CapacityHelp

data.name: Impact.CapacityPreview

data.name: Impact.CapacityReversal
data.value: A preview needs no rollback. Any later resource or subscription change follows its owning workflow.

data.name: Impact.CapacityScope
data.value: Positive headroom is remaining allowance; a negative value exceeds the observed base-plan limit. Entity plans share one allowance across personnel and units. Add-on seats, storage, provider quotas and prices are not included.

data.name: Impact.CapacityTiming
data.value: Billing observations can change. Existing plan enforcement remains authoritative when adding resources. No purchase, reservation, resource deletion or entitlement change is performed.

data.name: Impact.DispatchAttempts

data.name: Impact.DispatchDelivery
data.value: Route selection is not channel eligibility or delivery. Profiles, suppression, registrations, provider availability and other recipient gates can prevent a send. Review the authorized Calls and Communication Tests screens; this preview never dispatches or tests a channel.

data.name: Impact.DispatchFallback

A prospective default applies to future finalized revisions; older revisions keep the policy that applied when they became official. Definition overrides remain in force. Open, amending, recently changed and unexpired headers are excluded. Known parent and preservation holds and permanent casualty/rescue/exposure content are excluded; possible historical period holds remain uncertain. Child analyses and their holds, revision integrity, disclosure productions, evidence retention, attachments and external storage, workflow/outbox activity, submissions and search erasure still require the owning retention checks. Remaining candidates are not authorization or proof of purge eligibility.

Verify a working alternate administrator session and recovery procedure before changing policy.

Credential cutoff, generation, expiry, current request claims and tracking deployment determine actual reauthentication. Zero disables this department-specific idle check; it does not disable normal session expiry.

data.name: PackGap.emergency-response
data.value: The pack can organize declared sites, personnel, supply expiry and continuity references. Shelter capacity, welfare needs, external agency availability, deployment conflicts and actual communications coverage are not yet measured by these checks. Review those sources with the response coordinator.

data.name: PackGap.ems
data.value: The pack can flag credential expiry, configured staffing gaps and stock/check metadata. It does not verify clinical scope, patient-care protocols, drug administration authority, medical equipment suitability or patient handover completion. Use the approved clinical and logistics systems with their responsible owners.

data.name: PackGap.fire
data.value: The pack can flag configured roster vacancies, qualifications, equipment checks and holds. It does not verify apparatus minimum staffing, command competence, local response standards or pre-incident plans. Have the responsible fire-service owner review these sources and the fallback plan.

data.name: PackGap.hazmat
data.value: The pack can flag recorded qualifications, overdue checks, expiring supplies and safety holds. It does not infer Hazmat response level, instrument calibration compliance, exposure clearance or protective-equipment suitability. Review actual approved requirements with the Hazmat program owner.

data.name: PackGap.industrial
data.value: The pack can flag site-reference gaps, qualifications, equipment restrictions and supply expiry. Permit-to-work authority, process hazards, contractor clearance, site shutdown state and external plant alarms are not evaluated. The site response owner must verify those sources.

data.name: PackGap.mental-health
data.value: The pack can organize team coverage, protected access and current procedure references. After-hours referral ownership, crisis-service availability, clinical supervision and case handover are not yet measured. Confirm these with the responsible service owner without entering client narratives into setup.

data.name: PackGap.mutual-aid
data.value: The pack can organize shared-work areas, personnel and agreement references. External agency commitments, resource typing, cross-agency credentials, simultaneous assignments, cost eligibility and reimbursement acceptance are not verified. Confirm these with the participating agencies and finance owner.

data.name: PackGap.sar
data.value: The pack can flag configured roster gaps, credentials and overdue equipment checks. Search-sector coverage, terrain access, radio coverage, external resource location, missing-person case handling and mission suitability require their owning systems and a search-service reviewer.

data.name: PackGap.security
data.value: The pack can review scoped resource visibility, configured shifts, credentials and check-in configuration. Post orders, lone-worker response arrangements, client deadlines and actual site access are not verified by these checks. Review them with the responsible operations owner.

data.name: PackGapOwner
data.value: Capability-gap tracking owner: Resgrid.Core. Sector-specific acceptance review is pending; these prompts are not approved local operating requirements.

data.name: PackLocalRequirements
data.value: Use approved local requirements. Missing external evidence remains unknown; this report does not certify operational safety.

data.name: PackPurpose.emergency-response
data.value: Review activation rosters, volunteer onboarding, partner contacts and supplies.

data.name: PackPurpose.ems
data.value: Review qualification mix, ambulance checks, supply expiry and receiving contacts.

data.name: PackPurpose.fire
data.value: Review apparatus, qualified crew, run cards and mutual-aid arrangements.

data.name: PackPurpose.hazmat
data.value: Review locally approved qualifications, instrument checks, PPE and procedure review.

data.name: PackPurpose.industrial
data.value: Review site coverage, escalation, equipment restrictions and approved local procedures.

data.name: PackPurpose.mental-health
data.value: Review clinician, peer and interpreter coverage, escalation contacts and restricted records.

data.name: PackPurpose.mutual-aid
data.value: Review agency-specific recipients, agreements, resource typing and cost documentation.

data.name: PackPurpose.sar
data.value: Review specialty qualifications, team availability, equipment checks and check-in arrangements.

data.name: PackPurpose.security
data.value: Review site and post coverage, qualifications, check-in configuration and client deadlines.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AddCallData
data.value: Allows adding notes, images, files and video feeds to calls on the web and in the apps. People must also be able to see the call, and attaching a file on the web additionally needs call edit rights (department administrators or the member who logged the call). With the group-only box ticked, only department administrators and people whose group was dispatched on the call may add to it — also when the rule is Everyone. With no saved rule anyone who can see the call may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AddPersonnel
data.value: Allows adding, inviting and reactivating members. Choose department and group administrators to let group administrators add people to their own group; members they reactivate or add from an existing account also go into the group administrator's own group. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Group administrators who should also remove people need this set to include them, because removal checks it too.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AdjustInventory
data.value: Allows receiving, adjusting and archiving inventory, using stock from Records, and is the starting rule for Transfer and Issue until those are saved. With no saved rule only department administrators may, and the Security screen shows that.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AmendRecords
data.value: Allows opening an amendment on a finalized Record and abandoning it. The amendment is completed by finalizing, so pair this with Finalize Records. With no saved rule department and group administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ApproveRecords
data.value: Allows approving Records. Approval is currently done from the apps and API; on the web it only widens the accountability view. With no saved rule only department administrators may. An approver can never approve their own Record, and a definition's approver roles can narrow it further.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ApproveTimeReports
data.value: Allows approving and voiding submitted deployment time reports, including from the Incident Command app. Nobody can approve a report they submitted or that carries their own hours, so those need a second approver; voiding is still allowed. Once a report is approved, its expenses — and expenses for that day — can no longer be changed. On the web the approver also needs to see the deployment. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.BreakGlassProtectedData
data.value: A retired identifier kept so older saved settings still load. It grants nothing, is not shown on the Security screen and cannot be saved; staff support access is controlled by the support-consent setting on the Data Protection page.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CanSeePersonnelLocations
data.value: Decides whose positions a member may see: the map, live tracking, nearest-responder distances and travel times, status positions in personnel and call activity, check-ins and personnel event history. With the group-only box ticked, people see only members of their own group. With no saved rule everyone may. A position is withheld, not the person.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CanSeeUnitLocations
data.value: Decides whose unit positions a member may see: the map, live tracking, nearest-unit distances and travel times, unit event history and reports, check-ins, route deviations and call activity. With the group-only box ticked, people see only units of their own station. With no saved rule everyone may. A position is withheld, not the unit.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CloseCall
data.value: Allows closing and re-opening calls. With the group-only box ticked, only department administrators and people whose group was dispatched on the call may close or re-open it — also when the rule is Everyone. On the web, in the apps and in the chatbot people also need the call rights from Create Call. With no saved rule anyone who can see the call may close it.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CommandAppLogin
data.value: Decides who can run incident command: sign in to the Incident Command app, establish or reopen command, and work the boards where they hold incident capabilities (the incident commander and whoever established command hold all of them; assigned ICS roles grant parts). With no saved rule every active member may. When you save a narrower rule, the people it allows also get command-assist capabilities on any board. Who reads boards is View Command Boards, which follows this rule until it has its own.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewCommandBoards
data.value: Decides who can read every command board: the board, accountability, needs, timeline, map, roles, voice, resources and reports, the apps' offline sync of boards, the active commands list and dashboard widget, and the chatbot's incident answers. Members on an incident always read that incident's board: command staff, lane leads, members dispatched to the call directly or through their group, a personnel role or a unit they crew, and resources placed on the board. With no saved rule it follows Command App Login, and with neither rule every active member may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ConfigureProtectedDataEgress
data.value: Controls who may administer protected workflows and their release approvals. Turning a protected workflow on, approving or renewing it also needs a fresh step-up, and the SMS and voice PIN release settings additionally require a department administrator. Applies only when Advanced Data Protection is enrolled.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ContactDelete
data.value: Allows deleting contacts, categories, pre-plans, premise hazards and site files. With no saved rule everyone may. A contact with open billing in Business Ops cannot be deleted.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ContactEdit
data.value: Allows adding and editing contacts, categories, pre-plans, hazards and site files. With no saved rule everyone may. The edit page shows the whole contact, so anyone who can edit can also read; protected fields stay redacted without a Protected Data Grant.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ContactView
data.value: Allows viewing contacts, their notes, calls and files on the web and in the apps, finding them in search, and seeing contact details on calls: site information, contact alerts, the call contact pickers and the call export. With no saved rule everyone may, except inventory purchasing, which shows vendor contacts only to department administrators until you save a rule. Routes and the contact edit page can also show contact details.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateCalendarEntry
data.value: Allows creating and editing calendar entries and calendar types, and editing calendar check-ins from the apps. Editing or deleting an entry also needs to be its creator or a department administrator, and only the attendee themselves or someone who can edit the event may remove an attendee. Everyone can still view the calendar. With no saved rule everyone may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateCall
data.value: Allows creating calls, and with them the call rights that editing, closing, re-opening and deleting also need, on the web, in the apps, from the Logs page and in the chatbot. People who don't qualify can still view calls. With no saved rule everyone may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateDocument
data.value: Allows uploading documents. People can edit or delete only the documents they uploaded, unless they are department administrators. Everyone can still view documents. With no saved rule everyone may upload.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateLog
data.value: Allows writing logs. Everyone can still view them. Once Records is activated, legacy logs become read-only and this rule is copied to Create Record and Finalize Records. With no saved rule everyone may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateMessage
data.value: Allows sending messages, posting and reacting in chat, starting direct messages and using the chatbot, including sending a message by text to the chatbot. People without it can still read and delete their messages but cannot mark them read or edit chat posts. With no saved rule everyone may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateNote
data.value: Allows creating notes from the apps. On the web, creating, editing and deleting notes always needs a department administrator, whatever this rule says. Admin-only notes stay visible to department administrators only. With no saved rule everyone may create notes in the apps.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateRecord
data.value: Allows authoring Records, including incident reports, field records, evidence and attachments. With no saved rule everyone may author. Takes effect once Records is activated; activation copies your Create Log rule here. Field apps also need their Records field flags.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateShift
data.value: Allows creating, editing and deleting shifts and work shifts, and managing sign-ups for every group. Group administrators always manage sign-ups for their own groups. Members signing up — on the web, in the apps or through the chatbot — must follow the shift's rules (no past days, assigned shifts need an assignment, group shifts need the member's group). Everyone can still view shifts. With no saved rule only department administrators may change shifts.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateTraining
data.value: Allows creating trainings and authoring their content and quiz, including the answer key. Assigning and reporting (Assign Training) and archiving or deleting (Delete Training) are separate rules that follow this one until they are saved. Everyone can still view and complete the trainings assigned or open to them. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AssignTraining
data.value: Allows assigning trainings to members, setting due dates, extensions and exemptions, resetting members, and reading the training report and attempt history. Group admins act only on their own group's members. Until saved it follows Create Training.

data.name: PermissionHelp.DeleteTraining
data.value: Allows archiving, restoring and deleting trainings. A training someone completed is archived instead of deleted, so its completions stay on the record. Until saved it follows Create Training.

data.name: PermissionHelp.AuthorProtocols
data.value: Allows creating, copying and importing protocols, editing their library fields, triggers, questions and audience, writing drafts and submitting them for approval, disabling protocols and exporting the library. Authors also see drafts, the review queue and every protocol whatever its audience. Approving and publishing need Approve Protocols. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ApproveProtocols
data.value: Allows approving or rejecting submitted protocol versions, publishing them now or on a set date, recording "reviewed, no change", retiring and deleting protocols, placing a protocol's legal hold, and managing categories and their approval steps. Each approval is signed with a fresh step-up or a passkey. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: Permission.ManageCourses
data.value: Manage Courses

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageCourses
data.value: Allows building courses and question banks, uploading course video, submitting, approving and publishing course versions, assigning courses and reading course results. Each approval is signed with a fresh step-up. Courses are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet; Resgrid Academy lessons can be assigned with this permission or Assign Training. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: Permission.GradeAssessments
data.value: Grade Assessments

data.name: PermissionHelp.GradeAssessments
data.value: Allows grading free-text answers waiting in the grading queue and reading assessment item analysis. Nobody grades their own attempt. Part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageProtocolAcknowledgments
data.value: Reserved for read-and-sign acknowledgments: who will assign protocols for members to read and sign, exempt members and read the acknowledgment report. Read-and-sign is not available yet, so saving this rule changes nothing today. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.CreateWorkflow
data.value: Allows creating, editing and deleting workflows, previewing their conditions, reading step configuration in the apps and API, and seeing the rendered output of workflow runs. With no saved rule only department administrators can change workflows, but every member can open the Workflows page and read definitions; saving Department admins also hides workflows from everyone else. Steps that send a Records export also need Export Records and Manage Record Reports. Free plans are limited in how many workflows they can have.

data.name: PermissionHelp.DeleteCall
data.value: Allows deleting calls. With the group-only box ticked, only department administrators and people whose group was dispatched on the call may delete it — also when the rule is Everyone. People also need the call rights from Create Call. With no saved rule anyone who can see the call may delete it.

data.name: PermissionHelp.DeleteLog
data.value: Allows deleting logs. It is separate from Create Log. Once Records is activated, legacy logs become read-only and this rule is copied to Delete Record. With no saved rule everyone may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.DeleteRecord
data.value: Allows voiding Records and cancelling drafts — without it people cannot cancel even their own drafts. A member may void or cancel only Records they wrote, own, review or approve, unless they are a department administrator or the administrator of the Record's group. With no saved rule everyone may. Takes effect once Records is activated; activation copies your Delete Log rule here.

data.name: PermissionHelp.DispatchAppLogin
data.value: Decides who counts as a dispatcher. The Dispatch app checks it at sign-in (the server itself does not block sign-in), and dispatchers can read and are notified on dispatch-visible chat channels, including incident command and group channels. With no saved rule every active member counts. Saving it refreshes chat access.

data.name: PermissionHelp.EditProtectedCallData
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: editing protected call fields follows the normal call edit permissions plus a current Protected Data Grant. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ExportPayDataReporting
data.value: Allows freezing, exporting and downloading California pay data reports, and reading report runs and their totals. Per-worker snapshots and building the report need Manage Pay Data Reporting. Needs an active Business Ops add-on and Advanced Data Protection enabled. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ExportProtectedData
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: each export follows its own module's export permission. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ExportRecords
data.value: Allows printing and exporting Records, documents, deployment reports, saved-report CSVs and bulk packets. With no saved rule everyone may. Restricted sections additionally need View Restricted Records; managing export templates, opening other people's export runs and emailing a packet to an outside address need Manage Record Reports.

data.name: PermissionHelp.FinalizeRecords
data.value: Allows finalizing Records, which locks them as the official version. A member may finalize Records they wrote, own, review or approve; finalizing someone else's needs Review Records (Approve Records once approved, Amend Records for an amendment) or a department administrator. Amendments and corrections are also completed by finalizing, so anyone who amends needs this too. With no saved rule everyone may. Activation copies your Create Log rule here.

data.name: PermissionHelp.IssueInventory
data.value: Allows issuing equipment and supplies to people and units, taking returns, issuing kits and adding new holders. Until you save a rule here it follows Adjust Inventory. Controlled substances also need Manage Controlled Substances and, where required, a witness.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageBids
data.value: Allows creating, editing and deleting bids and quotes and converting them into deployments. Converting and using the deployment wizard also need Manage Deployments, and bid cost cards need View Internal Costs. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Contractor Billing and an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageCertificationSetup
data.value: Allows managing the certification catalog, templates, role requirements and enforcement settings. It does not by itself show members' certification records; that needs View Certifications. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageCertifications
data.value: Allows adding, verifying, editing and removing other members' and units' certification records and continuing-education credits. It includes viewing. Members can always manage their own records, but nobody can verify their own, and changing your own verified record clears its verification. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageChecklists
data.value: Allows authoring, publishing, retiring and scheduling checklists and sending checklist work to other groups. It does not include reading results. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Checklists turned on; failure actions that open work orders also need Work Orders and Readiness Pro.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageContracts
data.value: Allows viewing and managing service contracts and compliance documents, including the compliance checklist on a deployment's billing tab. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Contractor Billing and an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageControlledSubstances
data.value: Allows handling controlled-substance items: receiving, moving, issuing, using, witnessing, reporting and adding them to the catalog. It adds to the normal inventory permissions rather than replacing them, and witnessed steps need a second qualified person. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageDepartmentDataProtection
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: the Data Protection pages require a department administrator, and enrollment, offboarding, step-up exemptions and billing are limited to the managing member. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageDeployments
data.value: Allows creating and running deployments and external deployment orders: rosters, equipment, time, expenses and closeout, and marking expenses pre-approved. There is no separate view permission; members on a deployment's roster (directly or through their unit's crew on the roster) still see it — taking a seat on a deployed unit does not. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Creating from an external order also needs Create Record with Records activated.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageInvoicing
data.value: Allows creating, sending, editing and voiding invoices, generating invoices from deployments, downloading the invoice packet, recording payments and managing rate cards and billing profiles. It includes viewing. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Customer Invoicing turned on; changes need an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageMutualAidReimbursement
data.value: Allows preparing, handing off and reconciling Cal OES MARS reimbursement work. Building the salary survey also needs View Compensation, and classifications with fewer than three members are left out. Rostered members can still fill in their own F-42 and expenses, but printed packets show them no reimbursement rates or totals. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Cal OES MARS turned on and an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManagePayDataReporting
data.value: Allows building California pay data reports in the wizard and seeing the per-worker snapshots behind them. Freezing and exporting a report needs Export Pay Data Reporting. Every member still answers their own demographic questions. Needs the pay data reporting module, an active Business Ops add-on and Advanced Data Protection enabled. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRecordDefinitions
data.value: Allows creating and editing Record definitions in the designer. Publishing also needs Publish Record Definitions, and managing Record custom fields additionally requires a department administrator. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRecordDisclosures
data.value: Allows working public-records and disclosure requests, including reading the disclosure queue and producing releases. Restricted content additionally needs View Restricted Records. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRecordLegalHold
data.value: Allows placing and releasing legal holds, which stop Records from being purged. Holds on a specific Record are limited to Records the person can see. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRecordReports
data.value: Allows creating, scheduling and running saved Record reports, managing export templates, opening template and scheduled export runs, and emailing bulk packets to outside addresses; it also shows the accountability view. Export templates and CSV downloads also need Export Records, and restricted reports and runs need View Restricted Records. A bulk packet always opens only for the member who built it. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRoutes
data.value: Governs routes. It is not shown on any configuration screen, so members can view routes, group administrators can also create and edit them, and only department administrators can delete. Starting a route and checking in at stops need edit access. Viewing routes also shows the department's contacts.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageWorkOrders
data.value: Allows managing work orders across the department: approvals, costs, resolutions, holds, recurring maintenance, vendor charges and other groups' orders. It includes seeing every work order. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Work Orders turned on and the Readiness Pro add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageWorkflowCredentials
data.value: Allows creating, editing and deleting the credentials workflows use to reach outside services. Secrets are always masked. With no saved rule only department administrators can change them, but members can see credential names and types; saving Department admins hides those too, on the web and in the API. A credential that delivers a Records export also needs Export Records and Manage Record Reports to edit. Only useful alongside Create Workflow.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageWorkforceCompensation
data.value: Allows managing the employer profile, establishments, workers, employment and compensation records, and running cost runs. It includes viewing. Nobody can approve a compensation profile they last changed or their own pay. Pay amounts are protected and show redacted without a Protected Data Grant. Available on the web only. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Internal Costing and an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.PublishRecordDefinitions
data.value: Allows publishing and retiring Record definitions so people can use them. It only works together with Manage Record Definitions. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ReassignRecordDrafts
data.value: Allows handing someone else's draft Record to another active member. With no saved rule department and group administrators may, in any group they can see.

data.name: PermissionHelp.RecordsPreventionAdmin
data.value: Allows managing prevention data — occupancies, inspections, hydrants, permits and community risk reduction. Other members can still read it. Each area also needs its Records prevention module turned on. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.RemovePersonnel
data.value: Allows removing members from the department. Choose department and group administrators to let group administrators remove people in their own group — they also need Add Personnel set the same way, because the removal page checks it. A group administrator can never remove a department administrator or the managing member. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ReviewRecords
data.value: Allows reviewing Records and returning them for correction, and assigning review work. With no saved rule department and group administrators may. A definition's reviewer roles can narrow it further. Quality review also needs the Records quality review module.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ShareRecordsExternally
data.value: Reserved for sharing Records with other groups or outside agencies. No current feature uses it, so it is not offered on the Security screen; it defaults to department administrators only, and a rule saved earlier is kept for when sharing arrives.

data.name: PermissionHelp.SubmitRecords
data.value: Allows submitting Records to a reporting destination such as NERIS. Submitters must be able to see the Record; reading the submission exchange history also needs View Restricted Records, and validating a submission requires a department administrator. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.TransferInventory
data.value: Allows moving stock between locations. Until you save a rule here it follows Adjust Inventory. With the group-only box ticked, people can only move stock between locations in their own group. Controlled substances also need Manage Controlled Substances.

data.name: PermissionHelp.UseCalendarSync
data.value: Allows members to get a personal calendar subscription link for their phone or desktop calendar. The feed is re-checked on every fetch, so narrowing this stops existing feeds, and a member removed from or disabled in the department stops receiving it. With no saved rule everyone may. The operator must also have calendar feeds turned on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewAllWorkOrders
data.value: Allows seeing work orders beyond the ones you raised or are assigned. With no saved rule department administrators see all and group administrators see their own group's; the group-only box shows that limit ticked, so leave it ticked when you save if group administrators should stay limited to their group.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewCertifications
data.value: Allows viewing other members' and units' certifications, the expiring-certifications list and role eligibility. Members always see their own; group administrators need this permission too to see their members' records. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Protected fields need a Protected Data Grant.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewChecklistResults
data.value: Allows reading completed checklist results and history. With no saved rule department administrators see everything, group administrators see their own group's results, and everyone sees runs they created or witnessed. Untick the group-only box to let reviewers see every group.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewGroupRecords
data.value: Limits which groups' Records people can see. Scoping applies only when this rule's group-only box is ticked and Records Settings sets group visibility to group-scoped; then non-administrators see their own group's Records plus any they authored or take part in. The action and role choices on this row do not change visibility.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewGroupUnits
data.value: Decides which units a person can see in unit lists, pickers, the map, crew assignments, search, the chatbot and the apps, and whose status they may set. With the group-only box ticked, people see only units of their own station (department administrators always see every unit). With no saved rule everyone sees every unit.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewGroupUsers
data.value: Decides which members a person can see in personnel lists, profiles, grids, dispatch pickers, reports, search, the apps' roster and status feeds. With the group-only box ticked, group administrators and role holders see only their own group (department administrators always see everyone). With no saved rule everyone sees everyone.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewInternalCosts
data.value: Allows seeing the department's internal costs: resource cost profiles, usage, field cost runs and margin cards. Running, freezing or deleting cost runs, editing cost profiles and changing other people's usage also need Manage Labor and Compensation. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Needs Internal Costing turned on and an active Business Ops add-on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewInvoicing
data.value: Allows viewing invoices, aging, rate cards and contact billing profiles without changing them, including the invoice lists on deployments and contracts. The invoice packet (with time reports, receipts and compliance documents) needs Manage Invoicing. With no saved rule only department administrators may. Viewing keeps working if the Business Ops add-on lapses.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewLegacyRecords
data.value: Reserved for viewing legacy Logs history from Records. No current page uses it, so it is not offered on the Security screen; legacy history follows the Logs permissions. A rule saved earlier is kept.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewPersonalInfo
data.value: Decides who sees members' email addresses, phone numbers and mailing addresses on the personnel pages, the Personnel report (on screen and when scheduled by email), the profile editor and the apps. People without it still see names, groups, roles and statuses, and everyone always sees their own details. With no saved rule everyone may. Protected fields additionally need a Protected Data Grant.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewProtectedCallData
data.value: Controls who may receive protected call details by SMS or voice after entering their PIN. On-screen and app reveal is not governed by it; that follows call access plus a current Protected Data Grant. Applies only when Advanced Data Protection is enrolled and PIN release is turned on.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewProtectedContactData
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: anyone who can view contacts and holds a current Protected Data Grant can reveal protected contact fields. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewProtectedOperationalData
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: revealing protected logs, documents, calendar entries, custom fields and records follows each module's own access rules plus a current Protected Data Grant. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewProtectedPersonnelData
data.value: Not offered on the Security screen, because no runtime check reads it: anyone who can view a member and holds a current Protected Data Grant can reveal that member's protected fields. A rule saved earlier is kept but has no effect.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewRestrictedRecords
data.value: Allows seeing restricted Record sections such as casualty, exposure and investigation detail. It is also required to include restricted content in disclosures, exports and export runs, and to read the submission exchange history. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewUdfFields
data.value: Governs reading and saving custom field values through the apps and API. It is not shown on any configuration screen, so everyone keeps view and update access. Each value also follows its field's visibility setting and the record it belongs to: a member reads or fills in values only on calls, units, people and contacts they can see or edit. Managing custom field definitions always requires a department administrator.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewWorkflowRuns
data.value: Allows viewing workflow run history, logs, health and pending runs. What a run sent (its rendered output and result) is shown only to people who may edit workflows. With no saved rule every member can view runs and only department administrators can cancel or clear them; saving Department admins hides runs from everyone else, and saving Everyone lets everyone cancel and clear.

data.name: PermissionHelp.ViewWorkforceCompensation
data.value: Allows viewing the worker roster and compensation records without changing them, and is needed to build the Cal OES MARS salary survey. Amounts show redacted without a Protected Data Grant. Available on the web only. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-enrollment
data.value: Enforcement settings alone do not prove that every administrator has enrolled.

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-mfa
data.value: Administrative accounts control department access and configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.admin-succession
data.value: A single administrative account can make recovery difficult.

data.name: RuleWhy.checkin-timers
data.value: Automatic timers need applicable target configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.checklist-overdue
data.value: Recorded overdue checks need an owner and follow-up.

data.name: RuleWhy.command-sources
data.value: Both text calls and commands are selected without dispatch-source patterns. Member commands use verified identity; the patterns distinguish dispatch senders rather than granting every member permission.

data.name: RuleWhy.communication-tests
data.value: Configuration and device registration do not prove delivery.

data.name: RuleWhy.continuity-reference
data.value: The reviewed operating profile has no reference to a continuity or fallback procedure. The procedure may exist elsewhere; this is an administrative review prompt.

data.name: RuleWhy.credential-expiry
data.value: Expiring qualifications may affect upcoming assignments.

data.name: RuleWhy.email-import-failures
data.value: One or more configured mailboxes currently report a failed polling state. This is the latest stored observation, not proof of a continuing provider outage.

data.name: RuleWhy.empty-groups
data.value: An empty group has no members to receive its work.

data.name: RuleWhy.equipment-holds
data.value: Only the owning workflow can release a safety hold.

data.name: RuleWhy.import-heartbeat
data.value: Mailbox polling is compared with the interval declared in the operating profile. Missing calls alone do not imply an outage; absent or future poll timestamps remain unknown.

data.name: RuleWhy.map-style
data.value: An enabled map override needs a style configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.map-token
data.value: An enabled map override needs its provider credentials.

data.name: RuleWhy.new-call-dispatch-lists-hidden
data.value: New Call Form Fields hides the personnel, groups, roles and units lists, so a new call pages nobody unless All Call is ticked.

data.name: RuleWhy.notification-channels
data.value: Some visible active members have no eligible SMS, email or push preference under the ordinary notification sender. Push preference alone is not a valid registration or proof of delivery.

data.name: RuleWhy.notification-profiles
data.value: Missing member profiles prevent a complete channel eligibility assessment. Unknown eligibility must not be treated as no available channel.

data.name: RuleWhy.password-recovery
data.value: Sending a single-use recovery link avoids an administrator choosing a member password.

data.name: RuleWhy.person-location-age
data.value: A zero location lifetime can keep stale personnel positions on the map.

data.name: RuleWhy.personnel-limit
data.value: Adding members may exceed the current plan limit.

data.name: RuleWhy.policy-expiry
data.value: A linked staffing, qualification or continuity document is scheduled for removal within 30 days. This is document metadata, not a legal or clinical review deadline.

data.name: RuleWhy.policy-references
data.value: A declared policy document was removed, expired or is no longer in this department. Existence alone does not prove policy approval or suitability.

data.name: RuleWhy.qualified-coverage
data.value: Coverage follows approved local qualification and role requirements.

data.name: RuleWhy.record-review
data.value: Recorded due dates need administrative follow-up.

data.name: RuleWhy.run-cards
data.value: Enabled recommendations need reviewed run-card configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-auto-without-dispatch
data.value: Automatic shift status changes need shift dispatch enabled.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-coverage
data.value: An empty shift can cause group dispatch to fall back to every group member.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-open-slots
data.value: Resolved rosters do not fill every configured role slot in the next seven days.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-overlaps
data.value: The same person appears on duty in overlapping shifts in the next seven days.

data.name: RuleWhy.shift-trades
data.value: A requested or pending trade has not changed the resolved roster.

data.name: RuleWhy.site-references
data.value: An operating-profile group reference no longer belongs to this department or has been removed.

data.name: RuleWhy.station-address
data.value: Missing station locations reduce mapping and closest-resource usefulness.

data.name: RuleWhy.stock-expiry
data.value: Recorded lot expiry can affect supply availability.

data.name: RuleWhy.text-sources
data.value: Text call intake is selected without source patterns. Provider paths differ: this can broaden acceptance or prevent sender classification. The stored switch alone does not prove intake enforcement.

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-group
data.value: Group membership affects resource organization and routing.

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-limit
data.value: Adding units may exceed the current plan limit.

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-location-age
data.value: A zero location lifetime can keep stale unit positions on the map.

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-type
data.value: Unit types support consistent status and qualification configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.weather-zones
data.value: Enabled weather alerts need an applicable area configuration.

data.name: RuleWhy.workflow-failures
data.value: Observed failures can leave administrative work incomplete.
