data.name: SettingHelp.AllowSignupsForMultipleShiftGroups
data.value: Allow a member to sign up for multiple shift groups. Review overlaps and local coverage rules separately.

data.name: SettingHelp.AutoSetStatusForShiftDispatchPersonnel
data.value: Apply the configured status to shift-dispatched personnel. This only takes effect with shift dispatch enabled.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardHideUnavailable
data.value: Hide unavailable resources on the Big Board; this affects visibility, not their dispatch eligibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapCenterAddress
data.value: Address used to center the Big Board. Address details remain on their owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapCenterGpsCoordinates
data.value: Explicit board-center coordinates take precedence over address geocoding. Partial coordinates do not overwrite the saved center.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardMapZoomLevel
data.value: Initial Big Board map zoom. An unset override lets the consuming board select its default.

data.name: SettingHelp.BigBoardPageRefresh
data.value: Big Board refresh interval. Review load and the age of displayed information before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.BrainTreeCustomerId
data.value: Legacy billing reference. Use the subscription provider workflow, not a direct settings edit.

data.name: SettingHelp.CallsSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for displayed calls; does not reorder provider delivery or change call priority.

data.name: SettingHelp.CheckInTimersAutoEnableForNewCalls
data.value: Automatically start configured check-in timers for new calls. Review timer targets and escalation before enabling it.

data.name: SettingHelp.DepartmentOperatingProfile
data.value: Declared organization, workforce, dispatch, seasonal, language and policy context. Recommendations never infer licenses or clinical scope from this profile.

data.name: SettingHelp.DisabledAutoAvailable
data.value: Disables automatic availability behavior. Review staffing/status reset interactions before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationAutoDispatch
data.value: Allow the recommendation path to dispatch automatically where enabled. Preview recipients and verify local procedures first.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig
data.value: Location, ETA, rest, crew and move-up settings used by recommendation consumers. External ETA calls occur only in the owning operational flow.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRecommendationMode
data.value: Dispatch recommendation selection mode. Review run cards, eligible resources and human dispatch responsibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchShiftInsteadOfGroup
data.value: Expand dispatched groups using the resolved on-duty roster. An empty shift result falls back to group members; preview both cases.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableModernNotifications
data.value: Retired. Modern notification sounds are now on for every department and user; there is nothing to set.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableTextCommand
data.value: Configured text-command preference. Dispatch-source patterns and verified member command identity are different checks. Provider and chatbot paths do not enforce this switch uniformly; review the active consumer before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.EnableTextToCall
data.value: Configured text-call preference. Enforcement differs by provider and chatbot path; the stored value alone does not prove intake is stopped or accepted. Review sender classification and perform an explicit controlled verification on the owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.ForceChatbotSecurityPin
data.value: Require the member security PIN for sensitive supported chatbot and SMS actions, including members who have not opted in.

data.name: SettingHelp.GroupDispatchScopeConfig
data.value: Group-subtree dispatch visibility with explicit role exceptions. Preview each actor and target scope before changing it.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingLocationRetentionDays
data.value: Tracking retention bounded by host configuration and applicable holds. Shortening retention can make data eligible for deletion.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingMobileFallbackEnabled
data.value: Use supported mobile location fallback when hardware data is stale. Verify each device/source rather than assuming continuous tracking.

data.name: SettingHelp.HardwareTrackingStaleAfterSeconds
data.value: Age at which a hardware location becomes stale, clamped to at least one second. Review device reporting intervals.

data.name: SettingHelp.InternalDispatchEmail
data.value: Assigned internal dispatch email address. Presence can be shown; the address stays on the authorized import screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapboxAccessToken
data.value: Map-provider access token. Only presence is reported. Disabling the override deletes it and requires re-entry to restore.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapboxStyleUrl
data.value: Custom map style reference. Verify the provider style and credential together; disabling the override deletes this value.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingPersonnelAllowStatusWithNoLocationToOverwrite
data.value: Allow a personnel status without a location to replace the previous location-bearing state. This can remove a marker.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingPersonnelLocationTTL
data.value: Maximum personnel location age in minutes. Zero keeps stale positions visible without an age limit; assess actual ping ages.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUnitAllowStatusWithNoLocationToOverwrite
data.value: Allow a unit status without a location to overwrite earlier location data. Check hardware and app updates together.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUnitLocationTTL
data.value: Maximum unit location age in minutes. Zero retains stale unit locations indefinitely in supported map consumers.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingUseMapboxOverride
data.value: Use the department map provider override. Turning it off on the owning screen removes the stored style and token.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapStyle
data.value: Mapbox base map every department map shows in a light theme, on the website and in all apps. Automatic is Streets; the website needs a server Mapbox token, and the department Mapbox override replaces it everywhere. On a server that draws its own maps, only the styles it can render are offered.

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingMapStyleNight
data.value: Base map the apps show in dark mode. Automatic pairs with the day style (Dark for road maps, Navigation Night for Navigation Day; Outdoors and satellite unchanged). The website always uses the day style.

data.name: SettingHelp.ModuleSettings
data.value: Controls module navigation and supported feature gates. Hiding a module does not delete its records or prove independent dispatch settings are disabled.

data.name: SettingHelp.NewCallFieldPolicy
data.value: Controls which built-in fields and sections the call forms show and which must be filled in, on the web, in Omni and through the API. Hidden fields cannot be required; name, nature, priority and type are always shown and required. Hiding all four dispatch lists replaces them with an optional All Call, so a call left without it pages nobody.

data.name: SettingHelp.PaddleCustomerId
data.value: Billing-provider customer reference. Managed by authorized billing flows and never returned in assistant evidence.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelListStatusSortOrder
data.value: Custom ordering of personnel statuses in lists. Review all configured statuses before replacing the order.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelOnUnitSetUnitStatus
data.value: Allow personnel status updates to influence their assigned unit status. Review automation and crew assignment together.

data.name: SettingHelp.PersonnelSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for personnel lists; does not change availability, access or dispatch priority.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsDefaultLifecyclePreset
data.value: Default lifecycle for new department-owned definitions. Locked definitions retain their own lifecycle.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsDisclosureConfig
data.value: Disclosure review clock, redaction profile and release approver. Review local obligations through the authorized disclosure workflow.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsGroupScopeConfig
data.value: Reserved identifier with no editable behavior in this release. Do not present it as a shipped setting.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsGroupVisibilityMode
data.value: Whether record visibility is department-wide or group scoped. Group scope narrows existing permission and never grants access.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig
data.value: Department numbering for the built-in record types and incident reports: the number pattern, sequence digits, record type prefixes and raised next numbers. Numbers are assigned when a record is finalized. Department definitions with their own numbering keep it.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsRetentionPolicy
data.value: Default and definition-specific retention, including prior-policy history. Holds and restricted-class rules can prevent purge eligibility.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsNerisWorkflowsEnabled
data.value: Turns this department's NERIS validation, submission and NERIS setup screens on or off. Other Records settings, records and history are unchanged; the NERIS profile and queued submissions are kept for re-enabling.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsReviewDueHours
data.value: Default administrative review deadline; a definition-level override takes precedence. This is not a statutory deadline inference.

data.name: SettingHelp.RecordsSearchConfig
data.value: Allowed record search scope and protected-data behavior. Search access remains bounded by current source permissions.

data.name: SettingHelp.Require2FAForAdmins
data.value: Administrator MFA requirement mode. Verify actual factors and recovery for each administrator before enforcement changes.

data.name: SettingHelp.RequirePasswordResetViaEmail
data.value: Use single-use recovery links for administrator-initiated member password resets, instead of selecting a replacement password.

data.name: SettingHelp.RssFeedKeyForActiveCalls
data.value: Credential for the active-call feed. Treat the feed and its key as sensitive; rotate through its owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.ShiftCallDispatchPersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Personnel status applied when shift dispatch occurs. Minus one leaves status unchanged; use an existing approved status.

data.name: SettingHelp.ShiftCallReleasePersonnelStatusToSet
data.value: Personnel status applied on call release for the shift-dispatch path. Minus one leaves status unchanged.

data.name: SettingHelp.StaffingSuppressStaffingLevels
data.value: Staffing levels suppressed in supported notifications. Suppression can change who hears an alert and is not evidence of delivery.

data.name: SettingHelp.StripeCustomerId
data.value: Billing-provider customer reference managed by subscription workflows; never edit this as an ordinary department setting.

data.name: SettingHelp.TestEnabled
data.value: Department testing behavior. Do not treat enabling a test setting as proof of production readiness.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallImportFormat
data.value: Parser used for inbound text call creation. Verify the sender format with a controlled example on the owning screen.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallNumber
data.value: Provisioned inbound text number. Provisioning has external effects and must use the normal text settings flow.

data.name: SettingHelp.TextToCallSourceNumbers
data.value: Allowed inbound source numbers for text calls and commands. Empty sources prevent accepted intake; never display raw numbers in Admin Assist.

data.name: SettingHelp.TtsLanguage
data.value: Text-to-speech language for supported voice notifications. Confirm supported voices and pronunciation with a human-run test.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallDispatchStatusToSet
data.value: Unit status applied during call dispatch, by meaning: each unit gets the status of its own status set with that base type. -1 is the default, -2 leaves the status unchanged, 1000 plus a base type is a status meaning, and 0 to 12 is a built-in status saved before status meanings.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallReleaseStatusToSet
data.value: Unit status applied at call release, by meaning in the same way as the dispatch status. Review unit-type overrides before assuming one department-wide effect.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitCallStatusOverridesByUnitType
data.value: Per-unit-type call status overrides. Existing type-specific values take precedence over department defaults.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitDispatchAlsoDispatchToAssignedPersonnel
data.value: Expand unit dispatch to its assigned crew. Review duplicate routes, current assignments and recipient permissions.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitDispatchAlsoDispatchToGroup
data.value: Expand unit dispatch to the station group. This can substantially increase the recipient audience.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitStatusThresholds
data.value: Visual warning thresholds for time in a unit status. A highlight does not change the unit status or certify availability.

data.name: SettingHelp.UnitsSortOrder
data.value: Sort order for unit lists; does not change unit eligibility or dispatch recommendation ranking.

data.name: SettingHelp.UpdateTimestamp
data.value: Internal configuration timestamp. Read-only metadata, not an administrator-editable preference.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertAutoMessageSchedule
data.value: Schedule for automatic weather messaging. Review the department time zone, overnight periods and daylight-saving changes.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertAutoMessageSeverity
data.value: Minimum weather severity eligible for automatic messages. Review recipients, schedule and duplicate suppression.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertCacheMinutes
data.value: Weather cache duration; longer caching changes freshness and provider load.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertCallIntegration
data.value: Include supported weather context in call integration. It does not certify weather or route safety.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertExcludedEvents
data.value: Weather event types excluded from configured processing. Review exclusions against approved local procedures.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertMinimumSeverity
data.value: Minimum severity eligible for the weather-alert view. Severity values come from the weather service, not local incident triage.

data.name: SettingHelp.WeatherAlertsEnabled
data.value: Enable supported weather-alert processing. Configure zones and communication behavior before relying on it.

data.name: SetupEvidence.call-types-priorities
data.value: Call types are recorded. Review their names and priorities with your dispatchers.

data.name: SetupEvidence.certification-types
data.value: Certification types are recorded; the listed checks look for expiring and uncovered qualifications.

data.name: SetupEvidence.checkin-setup
data.value: Check-in timer configuration is recorded. Verify target selection, deadlines, escalation ownership and a controlled scenario through the owning screen.

data.name: SetupEvidence.checklists
data.value: Checklists are recorded; the listed check looks for overdue checks.

data.name: SetupEvidence.distribution-lists
data.value: Distribution lists are recorded. Review each list before sending to it.

data.name: SetupEvidence.email-intake
data.value: Mailbox configuration and available polling metadata are checked. Parser success, routing and page delivery require a controlled authorized test.

data.name: SetupEvidence.groups
data.value: Checks recorded group membership and station location metadata. Review intended dispatch and site coverage separately.

data.name: SetupEvidence.notifications
data.value: Notification rules are recorded. Review who each rule alerts, then run a communication test.

data.name: SetupEvidence.personnel
data.value: Current active members are recorded. This does not verify invitations, account access, role assignment or qualifications.

data.name: SetupEvidence.personnel-roles
data.value: Roles are recorded. Check on the Personnel screen that members have the roles they need.

data.name: SetupEvidence.protocols
data.value: Dispatch protocols are recorded. Review them with your dispatchers.

data.name: SetupEvidence.run-cards
data.value: Run-card records are present. The listed check verifies presence when recommendations are enabled, not correctness of local response requirements.

data.name: SetupEvidence.shifts
data.value: Upcoming shifts are scheduled; the listed checks look for open slots, overlaps and unfinished trades.

data.name: SetupEvidence.trainings
data.value: Trainings are recorded. Review assignments and completion on the Trainings screen.

data.name: SetupEvidence.unit-types
data.value: Unit types are recorded; the listed check confirms every unit has one.

data.name: SetupEvidence.units
data.value: Checks recorded unit types and groups. Crew suitability, device setup and actual communications need separate verification.

data.name: SetupEvidence.weather
data.value: Weather zones are recorded. Confirm geographic coverage and the actual provider and notification path.

data.name: SetupEvidence.workflows
data.value: Workflows are recorded; the listed check looks for recent failed runs.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.AllowDispatchViaChatbot
data.value: Permits supported chatbot dispatch actions subject to their own authorization and confirmation. Enabling it may allow real calls and pages.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.AllowedPlatforms
data.value: Allowed chatbot platform codes; the stored asterisk represents the platform default. Review each connected provider and its account-linking requirements.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.IsEnabled
data.value: Department chatbot availability. Platform feature rollout, account linking and action permissions are separate gates.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmApiEndpoint
data.value: Optional existing chatbot model endpoint. Phase 0 Admin Assist does not call it and does not use chatbot configuration as an AI entitlement.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmApiKey
data.value: Credential for the chatbot model provider. Never copy it into setup metadata or public reference content.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.LlmModelName
data.value: Model identifier used by the existing chatbot integration. This is separate from the later Admin Assist open-source inference deployment.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MaxSessionsPerUser
data.value: Maximum chatbot sessions per member in supported consumers. This is separate from authenticated web/mobile session limits.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MessagesPerDepartmentPerMinute
data.value: Optional department chatbot rate bound. Consider shared demand and provider quotas before changing it.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.MessagesPerUserPerMinute
data.value: Optional per-member chatbot rate bound. Review provider limits and burst behavior; this is not a delivery guarantee.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.ProactiveNotificationsEnabled
data.value: Allows supported proactive chatbot notifications. Recipient permissions, channel configuration and sending workflows remain authoritative.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.RequireConfirmationForStatusChange
data.value: Requests confirmation for supported status changes. Review each platform consumer before assuming all commands are covered.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.RequireLinkingConfirmation
data.value: Requires confirmation in the supported account-linking flow. Linking must not bypass verified identity or departmental authorization.

data.name: TableHelp.ChatbotDepartmentConfig.SessionTtlMinutes
data.value: Chatbot session lifetime in minutes. Expiry does not revoke an unrelated Resgrid sign-in session.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.AddressId
data.value: Department address reference. Review the owning address and mapping consumers; it is separate from station and site addresses.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.ApiKey
data.value: Department API credential. Never place it in setup notes or model input; manage and rotate it through the authorized workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.Code
data.value: Department code used by supported identification and access flows. Review those consumers before changing it.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.DepartmentType
data.value: Organization-type label, set on Department Settings. It never limits templates, packs or modules. The operating profile records several sectors; neither establishes clinical scope or response qualifications.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.LinkCode
data.value: Department linking code. Review who can use a link and rotate it using the owning workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.ManagingUserId
data.value: Managing-member identity. Subscription and high-risk account operations may require this member; change ownership through its explicit owning workflow.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.Name
data.value: Department display name. Review member-facing labels and documents that snapshot the name; changing it does not rename historical artifacts.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.PublicApiKey
data.value: Credential used by supported public API consumers. Public in the field name does not make credential disclosure safe.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.SharedSecret
data.value: Department integration secret. Rotation can affect integrations and needs coordinated verification.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.ShowWelcome
data.value: Legacy welcome flag. Restored setup dismissal is per administrator and does not use this flag as evidence of setup completion.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.TimeZone
data.value: Department time zone used by scheduling and local-date reports. Review overnight shifts and daylight-saving transitions before changing it.

data.name: TableHelp.Department.Use24HourTime
data.value: Preferred time display. This does not change stored timestamps or the department time zone.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.ErrorMessage
data.value: Provider/import error details on the authorized screen. Admin Assist uses a normalized failure indication and does not copy provider bodies.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.FormatType
data.value: Selects the inbound email parser. Verify representative permitted source messages without sending an operational page unintentionally.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Hostname
data.value: Mailbox host for email intake. Review the approved provider and network reachability without exposing credentials in setup guidance.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.IsFailure
data.value: Latest recorded mailbox failure flag. Verify a new poll before treating it as a continuing outage or a resolved problem.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.LastCheck
data.value: Last recorded polling timestamp. Missing or future timestamps are unknown; quiet call volume is not proof of a poll failure.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Password
data.value: Mailbox credential. Do not copy it into Admin Assist; rotate it through the mailbox and owning editor together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Port
data.value: Mailbox connection port. It must match the selected provider and TLS mode.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.UseSsl
data.value: Mailbox transport encryption option. Verify actual provider compatibility and successful polling; a stored flag alone does not prove transport protection.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentCallEmail.Username
data.value: Mailbox account identifier used for intake. It remains on the authorized configuration screen.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.BeforeData
data.value: Previous-state filter for applicable events. Review valid status IDs and the event-specific interpretation of an empty or wildcard value.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.CurrentData
data.value: Current-state filter for applicable events. Compare it with the previous-state filter to avoid unintended volume.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Data
data.value: Event-specific configuration payload. The owning editor validates its meaning; Admin Assist does not execute arbitrary stored expressions.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.DepartmentAdmins
data.value: Includes department administrators in supported notification processing. Review overlap and channel eligibility before estimating volume.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Disabled
data.value: Stored disabled marker. The inspected legacy notification processor does not consult this flag, so it must not be treated as a verified stop switch. Review the active consumer; queued and delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.EventType
data.value: Event that can trigger this notification rule. Match the event to a real administrative responsibility and expected frequency.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.Everyone
data.value: Selects the department-wide recipient option. Review actual active membership, suppression and deduplication before use.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.GroupsToNotify
data.value: Department-group recipients. Review group membership and lock-to-group behavior together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.LockToGroup
data.value: Restricts applicable event processing to group scope. Review the selected event's actual source group and recipient resolver.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.LowerLimit
data.value: Lower threshold for event-specific alerts. Use approved local thresholds and verify the actual event interpretation.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.RolesToNotify
data.value: Personnel-role recipients. Role membership can change; a role label is not a qualification or delivery guarantee.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.SelectedGroupsAdminsOnly
data.value: Limits selected-group recipients to their administrators in supported event paths. It does not designate department administrators automatically.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.UpperLimit
data.value: Upper threshold for event-specific alerts. Units and comparisons depend on the selected event.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentNotification.UsersToNotify
data.value: Explicit member recipients. Membership and channel eligibility are evaluated separately at send time.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AcceptRecentLoginMfaForAdp
data.value: Lets MFA completed at sign-in in the same session open protected data within the step-up window, for methods the protected-data settings allow. Changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AcceptRecentUnlockMfaForAdp
data.value: Lets the operator's fresh unlock verification on a shared device open protected data. Changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowFederatedMfaForAdp
data.value: Accepts the identity provider's MFA for protected data. Requires a tested MFA mapping; changing it ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowFederatedMfaForLoginMfa
data.value: Accepts the identity provider's MFA for sign-in and step-up. Requires a tested MFA mapping on the SSO configuration; without one the provider's claims never count. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowPasskeysForAdp
data.value: Accepts a passkey for protected-data access, ADP management and protected-workflow approvals. Authenticator codes are always accepted. Changing it ends current protected-data access, so members verify again. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowPasskeysForLoginMfa
data.value: Accepts a passkey registered in the requesting app as MFA for sign-in, department entry and step-up. Authenticator codes are always accepted. Changing it advances the MFA policy version; sessions whose only second factor is now disallowed verify again. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowResponderApproval
data.value: Accepts approval with the member's Responder app passkey wherever the matching passkey setting is on; never for security changes or account sign-in methods. Changing it also ends current protected-data access. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.AllowedIpRanges
data.value: Allowed login network ranges. Empty adds no range restriction. Review legitimate responder networks and recovery access before narrowing it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.DataClassificationLevel
data.value: Department classification label. Selecting it does not enroll ADP, establish compliance or automatically classify every record correctly.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.MaxConcurrentSessions
data.value: Maximum policy-managed concurrent sessions per user; zero means unlimited for this setting. Existing sessions and enforcement rollout must be checked separately.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.MinPasswordLength
data.value: Minimum length offered by the policy editor. Actual password validators and supported credential-change paths remain authoritative.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.PasswordExpirationDays
data.value: Password age in days; zero disables this policy's age limit. Verify local-password and SSO behavior separately.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequireMfa
data.value: Department-wide MFA policy, distinct from the administrator-only setting. Review enrollment, supported factors and recovery before enforcement.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequirePasswordComplexity
data.value: Stored complexity preference. Consumer and editor coverage must be verified before relying on this field; it is not proof that an existing password meets a rule.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.RequireSso
data.value: Requires the supported SSO policy gate. Verify the active identity provider and local recovery arrangements before removing a sign-in path.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.SessionTimeoutMinutes
data.value: Idle timeout in minutes; zero defers to host behavior. Verify policy-managed sessions and each supported client rather than assuming immediate global logout.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.SharedIdleLockMinutes
data.value: Minutes without operator activity before a shared vehicle tablet or workstation session locks, from 1 to 15. Background updates and incoming alerts are not activity. A stricter value reaches running sessions at their next request. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.SharedModeRequiredApps
data.value: Unit, IC and Dispatch sessions this department always runs as shared sessions, whatever the installation is set to; sign-ins that do not name their app count too. Needs app versions that support shared mode. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSecurityPolicy.SharedShiftHours
data.value: Hours after sign-in when a shared session ends whatever the activity, from 1 to 24. A shorter value ends running sessions sooner; a longer one never extends them. Managing member only.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AllowLocalLogin
data.value: Allows a local-password path alongside this provider where policy permits. Review the department-wide SSO requirement and recovery plan together.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AssertionConsumerServiceUrl
data.value: Stored SAML callback configuration. Use the endpoint supplied by the owning SSO setup and verify the provider registration.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AttributeMappingJson
data.value: Maps provider attributes to supported member fields. Validate identity matching and missing attributes with an approved test account.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.Authority
data.value: OIDC issuer or authority. Verify the intended tenant, discovery metadata and callback registration before enabling it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.AutoProvisionUsers
data.value: Allows the supported sign-in flow to create members. Review identity matching, capacity and default assignments before enabling it.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.ClientId
data.value: Client registration identifier from the identity provider. Keep tenant and audience registration consistent with the owning SSO flow.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.DefaultRankId
data.value: Department rank assigned by supported automatic provisioning. It does not grant permissions or prove qualifications.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedClientSecret
data.value: Encrypted provider client secret. The secret is entered and rotated on the authorized provider editor; Admin Assist only describes its purpose.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedIdpCertificate
data.value: Encrypted provider verification certificate material. Review expiry and rotation through SSO; this description is not certificate validation.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedScimBearerToken
data.value: Encrypted credential for inbound SCIM requests. Rotate through the explicit token workflow and update the provider before retiring an old credential.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EncryptedSigningCertificate
data.value: Encrypted signing certificate and private-key material. Do not copy it into notes, logs or assistant messages.

data.name: TableHelp.DepartmentSsoConfig.EntityId
data.value: SAML service-provider identifier registered at the identity provider. It must agree with the configured integration.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.InQuartersTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / In-Quarters Turnout Seconds

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.InQuartersTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Seconds a unit at its station needs before it is moving; applies to In Quarters statuses and units with no GPS position. Added to travel time when ranking closest units; zero means none.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.MobileTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Mobile Turnout Seconds

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.MobileTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Seconds a unit that is already out and available needs before it is moving; applies to units ranked from GPS. Added to travel time when ranking closest units; zero means none.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.ClosestUnitRanking
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Closest Unit Ranking

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.ClosestUnitRanking
data.value: How closest-unit picks and the nearest-unit board order candidates: fastest response (turnout plus travel, with routed drive times when enabled; the default) or shortest straight-line distance.

data.name: Setting.StatusHoldToConfirm
data.value: Hold to Set Status

data.name: SettingHelp.StatusHoldToConfirm
data.value: Unit and Responder apps set a status with a two-second press and hold instead of a tap followed by Next or Submit. Statuses that need a note or destination still open that step.

data.name: Setting.CloseCallWhenUnitsClear
data.value: Close Call When Last Unit Clears

data.name: SettingHelp.CloseCallWhenUnitsClear
data.value: An active call closes on its own when its last dispatched unit reports back in service or out of service. Units still working, a call with no unit dispatched and a call under an active incident command keep it open.

data.name: Setting.TransportDestinationChecks
data.value: Transport Destination Checks

data.name: SettingHelp.TransportDestinationChecks
data.value: When a unit's Transporting or At Hospital status goes to a destination other than its call's assigned destination, the apps require a reason and the change is noted on the call.

data.name: Setting.CallNumberingConfig
data.value: Call Numbering Config

data.name: SettingHelp.CallNumberingConfig
data.value: How new call numbers are written: the call number pattern and sequence digits, plus a raised next number for departments continuing numbers issued before Resgrid. Changing it never renumbers calls that already have a number.

data.name: Field.CallNumberingConfig.Pattern
data.value: Call Numbering Config / Pattern

data.name: FieldHelp.CallNumberingConfig.Pattern
data.value: How call numbers are written, for example FD-2026-0153: fixed text plus the YYYY or YY, MM, DD, HH (hour), MIN (minute) and SEQ tokens. The sequence starts again whenever the date it writes changes; the hour and minute never restart it. Until a pattern is saved, calls keep the YY-SEQ numbers Resgrid has always issued.

data.name: Field.CallNumberingConfig.SequenceWidth
data.value: Call Numbering Config / Sequence Width

data.name: FieldHelp.CallNumberingConfig.SequenceWidth
data.value: Digits in the SEQ part of the call number, zero-padded: 4 writes 0153. 1 to 8 digits, 1 for no padding; changing it keeps the sequence's next number.

data.name: Feature.pending-calls
data.value: Pending Calls

data.name: FeaturePurpose.pending-calls
data.value: Calls saved for a dispatcher to send later, such as follow-ups another system feeds in; nobody is notified until the call is dispatched.

data.name: Feature.scheduled-calls
data.value: Scheduled Calls

data.name: FeaturePurpose.scheduled-calls
data.value: Calls that go out by themselves at a future time and can be sent early or rescheduled, with a calendar of every scheduled and recurring call.

data.name: Feature.api-keys
data.value: API keys

data.name: FeaturePurpose.api-keys
data.value: Let another system call the Resgrid API for the department with its own key, scopes, expiry and allowed addresses instead of a member's login.

data.name: FeatureValue.api-keys
data.value: Integrations keep working when people leave, can only do what their key allows and can be revoked at once.

data.name: Field.CallNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Call Numbering Config / Year Start Month

data.name: FieldHelp.CallNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Month the numbering year starts, for calls numbered by a fiscal year. A yearly pattern starts again at 1 on that month and day, and YYYY and YY write the fiscal year's name; patterns with MM or DD follow the calendar. Unset is January, the calendar year.

data.name: Field.CallNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Call Numbering Config / Year Start Day

data.name: FieldHelp.CallNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Day of the month the numbering year starts, 1 to the month's last day; February 29 is not allowed. Unset is the 1st.

data.name: Field.CallNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Call Numbering Config / Year Label

data.name: FieldHelp.CallNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Which year names a numbering year that does not start on January 1: the year it ends in (the usual fiscal-year convention, so a year starting November 1, 2026 is 2027) or the year it starts in.

data.name: Field.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Records Numbering Config / Year Start Month

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Month the numbering year starts, for records numbered by a fiscal year such as a county's or state's. Sequences that include the year start again at 1 on that month and day, and YYYY and YY write the fiscal year's name. Unset is January, the calendar year. Separate from call numbering's year start. Records request numbers and the numbers of inspections, permits, occupancies, investigations and evidence follow the same year.

data.name: Field.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Records Numbering Config / Year Start Day

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Day of the month the numbering year starts, 1 to the month's last day; February 29 is not allowed. Unset is the 1st.

data.name: Field.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Records Numbering Config / Year Label

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Which year names a numbering year that does not start on January 1: the year it ends in (the usual fiscal-year convention, so a year starting November 1, 2026 is 2027) or the year it starts in.

data.name: Setting.DocumentNumberingConfig
data.value: Document Numbering Config

data.name: SettingHelp.DocumentNumberingConfig
data.value: How work order, invoice, bid and daily time report numbers are written, and the day their numbering year starts. A document kind with no pattern keeps its built-in numbers.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Document Numbering Config / Year Start Month

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearStartMonth
data.value: Month the numbering year starts for work orders, invoices, bids and daily time reports numbered by a fiscal year. Work order numbers and patterns that include the year start again at 1 on that month and day, and YYYY and YY write the fiscal year's name. Unset is January, the calendar year.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Document Numbering Config / Year Start Day

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearStartDay
data.value: Day of the month the numbering year starts, 1 to the month's last day; February 29 is not allowed. Unset is the 1st.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Document Numbering Config / Year Label

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberingConfig.YearLabel
data.value: Which year names a numbering year that does not start on January 1: the year it ends in (the usual fiscal-year convention, so a year starting November 1, 2026 is 2027) or the year it starts in.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberingConfig.Patterns
data.value: Document Numbering Config / Patterns

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberingConfig.Patterns
data.value: The department's own number pattern for work orders, invoices, bids and daily time reports, in the call number tokens (YYYY or YY, MM, DD, SEQ). A document kind with no pattern keeps its built-in numbers (WO-2026-000019, #1042). A new pattern carries on after any number it would repeat. Members see the number as issued on documents, PDFs and exports, and for daily time reports in the Responder, Unit, IC and Dispatch apps.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberPattern.Kind
data.value: Document Number Pattern / Kind

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberPattern.Kind
data.value: The document the pattern numbers: work-order, invoice, bid or time-report, or for Records records-request, occupancy, inspection, permit, investigation or evidence.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberPattern.Pattern
data.value: Document Number Pattern / Pattern

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberPattern.Pattern
data.value: Fixed text around the YYYY or YY, MM, DD and SEQ tokens, with SEQ exactly once. Every number it writes must fit the document's number column: 50 characters, or 32 for occupancy, inspection, permit, investigation and evidence numbers.

data.name: Field.DocumentNumberPattern.SequenceWidth
data.value: Document Number Pattern / Sequence Width

data.name: FieldHelp.DocumentNumberPattern.SequenceWidth
data.value: Digits the sequence is padded to with leading zeros, 1 to 8; the sequence is counted as a number, so changing the width never restarts it.

data.name: Field.RecordsNumberingConfig.DocumentPatterns
data.value: Records Numbering Config / Document Patterns

data.name: FieldHelp.RecordsNumberingConfig.DocumentPatterns
data.value: The department's own patterns for records request, occupancy, inspection, permit, investigation and evidence numbers. They follow this setting's numbering year start; a kind with no pattern keeps its built-in numbers (PRR-2026-0001, INSP-2026-0001 and so on).

data.name: Feature.document-numbering
data.value: Document Numbering

data.name: FeaturePurpose.document-numbering
data.value: How work order, invoice, bid and daily time report numbers are written, and the day their numbering year starts for fiscal-year numbering.

data.name: Setting.DepartmentTerminology
data.value: Department Terminology

data.name: SettingHelp.DepartmentTerminology
data.value: The department's own names for modules, with the word for one item (Team for Units renamed Teams), and for built-in record types. They are carried through the website's navigation, page titles, buttons, column headings, messages and exports, and shown in the Responder, Unit, IC and Dispatch apps, in every language. Labels only: permissions, links, API values and members' own text do not change. A term with no name uses Resgrid's.

data.name: Field.DepartmentTerminologyConfig.Terms
data.value: Department Terminology / Terms

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentTerminologyConfig.Terms
data.value: One entry per renamed module or record type, for example Incident for Run or Shift On Duty for Work. A module entry can also hold the word for one item, such as Team for Units renamed Teams; left empty, it is worked out from the name. A term not listed shows Resgrid's name in the member's language. Names are at most 50 characters.

data.name: Field.DepartmentTermOverride.Key
data.value: Department Term / Key

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentTermOverride.Key
data.value: The term being renamed: a module (module.calls, module.records ...) or a built-in record type (record-type.run, record-type.work ...). Keys never change.

data.name: Field.DepartmentTermOverride.Text
data.value: Department Term / Name

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentTermOverride.Text
data.value: The department's word for the term, at most 50 characters. The same word shows for every member in every language; empty uses Resgrid's name.

data.name: Feature.terminology
data.value: Terminology

data.name: FeaturePurpose.terminology
data.value: Rename modules and built-in record types to the words your department uses, such as Incident instead of Run.

data.name: Rule.status-meanings
data.value: Status options have no meaning

data.name: RuleWhy.status-meanings
data.value: Dispatch, availability, notifications and the apps read a status by its meaning; an option without one is treated as unknown.

data.name: RuleNext.status-meanings
data.value: Open each listed status set and give its options a meaning; the suggested meanings are a starting point.

data.name: Rule.unit-status-targets
data.value: Unit types cannot take the dispatch or release status

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-status-targets
data.value: Their status set has no option with the meaning Dispatch Settings applies, so their units keep their status when dispatched or released.

data.name: RuleNext.unit-status-targets
data.value: Give the set's options meanings, or choose another meaning or a unit-type override in Dispatch Settings.

data.name: Field.UnitStatusThresholds.AcknowledgementNoteRequirement
data.value: Unit Status Thresholds / Acknowledgement Note Requirement

data.name: FieldHelp.UnitStatusThresholds.AcknowledgementNoteRequirement
data.value: Whether acknowledging or muting a status timer alert needs a reason: optional, required for alerts, or required for warnings and alerts. It does not change the timers or the unit status.

data.name: Rule.unit-status-timers
data.value: Dispatched units that can't be timed

data.name: RuleWhy.unit-status-timers
data.value: Unit status timers are set, but some unit types go on dispatch to a status with no meaning, or to a meaning with no timer. The Big Board never flags those units, however long they wait.

data.name: RuleNext.unit-status-timers
data.value: Give the dispatch status a meaning in Custom Statuses, or set a timer for its meaning in Mapping Settings.

data.name: Permission.ManageDepartmentImport
data.value: Manage Department Import

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageDepartmentImport
data.value: Who can use Import & Migration to bring data into the department: upload files, match columns, fix issues, approve and commit imports, roll them back, activate imported people and grant Resgrid support access. Department administrators only; it is not offered on the Security screen.

data.name: Permission.ManageRecordImports
data.value: Manage Record Imports

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageRecordImports
data.value: Who can import third-party incident history into Records and delete an import batch. Department administrators only. It is reserved for historical Records imports and is not yet offered on the Security screen.

data.name: Setting.DepartmentImportConfig
data.value: Department Import Config

data.name: SettingHelp.DepartmentImportConfig
data.value: How Import & Migration keeps uploaded files and checked data, whether an import needs a second administrator to approve it, how new imports treat existing records and how long Resgrid support access lasts by default.

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.ArtifactRetentionDaysAfterSuccess
data.value: Department Import Config / File Retention After Import

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.ArtifactRetentionDaysAfterSuccess
data.value: Days uploaded files are kept after their data is imported. Unset keeps them 7 days; departments using Advanced Data Protection keep them 72 hours.

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.ArtifactRetentionDaysAfterFailure
data.value: Department Import Config / File Retention After Failure

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.ArtifactRetentionDaysAfterFailure
data.value: Days uploaded files are kept after an import fails or is cancelled. Unset keeps them 30 days.

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.StagingRetentionDaysAfterActivation
data.value: Department Import Config / Checked Data Retention After Activation

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.StagingRetentionDaysAfterActivation
data.value: Days the checked rows, issues and value matches are kept after activation, so an import can still be explained or rolled back. Unset keeps them 30 days.

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.RequireSecondApprover
data.value: Department Import Config / Require Second Approver

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.RequireSecondApprover
data.value: When on, an import starts only after a second, different administrator also approves it.

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.DefaultWriteMode
data.value: Department Import Config / Default Write Mode

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.DefaultWriteMode
data.value: How new imports treat records that already exist: create only (the default: existing records are reported and skipped) or reviewed update (approved fields of matched records are updated).

data.name: Field.DepartmentImportConfig.SupportGrantDefaultDays
data.value: Department Import Config / Support Access Length

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentImportConfig.SupportGrantDefaultDays
data.value: How many days Resgrid support access lasts when you grant it without choosing a length. Unset is 7 days; the longest is 30.

data.name: Ui.OpenImport
data.value: Open Import & Migration

data.name: SetupEvidence.import-migration
data.value: Complete when an import has been verified in Import & Migration.

data.name: Rule.import-blocking-issues
data.value: An import has been stuck on blocking issues for over a week

data.name: RuleWhy.import-blocking-issues
data.value: Data waiting in Import & Migration is not in Resgrid yet, so people, stations or apparatus may be missing.

data.name: RuleNext.import-blocking-issues
data.value: Open Import & Migration and fix or exclude the blocking rows, or ask Resgrid support.

data.name: Rule.import-unreconciled
data.value: An import finished with unexplained differences

data.name: RuleWhy.import-unreconciled
data.value: The check after the import counted something different from what was written, so the data may not match your source.

data.name: RuleNext.import-unreconciled
data.value: Compare the counts in the import's history and ask Resgrid support if they do not match.

data.name: Rule.import-dormant-members
data.value: Imported people have not been invited for over two weeks

data.name: RuleWhy.import-dormant-members
data.value: Imported people cannot sign in and receive no dispatches until they are invited.

data.name: RuleNext.import-dormant-members
data.value: Invite them from Verify & activate, or remove people who should not be in Resgrid.

data.name: Rule.import-paused-intake
data.value: Call intake created by an import is still paused

data.name: RuleWhy.import-paused-intake
data.value: Calls from your CAD do not arrive in Resgrid while intake is paused.

data.name: RuleNext.import-paused-intake
data.value: Test a sample message, then enable intake from Verify & activate.

data.name: Rule.import-disabled-automation
data.value: Automation created by an import is still switched off

data.name: RuleWhy.import-disabled-automation
data.value: Checklist schedules, maintenance plans, scheduled tasks or workflows from the import do not run while they are disabled.

data.name: RuleNext.import-disabled-automation
data.value: Review them and switch on the ones you need from Verify & activate.

data.name: Rule.import-enforcement-relaxed
data.value: Certification enforcement relaxed by an import is still relaxed

data.name: RuleWhy.import-enforcement-relaxed
data.value: Role requirements only warn instead of being enforced.

data.name: RuleNext.import-enforcement-relaxed
data.value: Switch certification enforcement back on once certifications are complete.

data.name: Rule.import-files-retained
data.value: Imported files are kept longer than usual

data.name: RuleWhy.import-files-retained
data.value: Uploaded files can contain personal information; keeping them longer than needed adds risk.

data.name: RuleNext.import-files-retained
data.value: Delete files you no longer need, or shorten retention in the Import & Migration settings.

data.name: Feature.custom-map-icons
data.value: Custom map icons

data.name: FeaturePurpose.custom-map-icons
data.value: Your own icons for unit types, call types, points of interest, personnel roles and stations, shown in lists, the apps and on the map.

data.name: FeatureSetup.custom-map-icons
data.value: Upload a square PNG with a transparent background, 128 × 128 px or larger, on the unit type, call type, POI type or role page; the page previews it on a light and a dark map. To choose which icon a person with several roles shows, order the roles on the Roles page. Use Status map icons or Priority map icons on the same page to add an icon for each status or priority. For stations, upload one icon for all stations, or give a station its own, under Groups > Station icons or on the station's Edit Group page.

data.name: Feature.map-icon-legend
data.value: Map icon legend

data.name: FeaturePurpose.map-icon-legend
data.value: Every icon the map shows for calls, units and personnel in each priority and status, with the status and priority colors.

data.name: FeatureSetup.map-icon-legend
data.value: Open Mapping, then Map Icon Legend. Department admins can choose Edit icons on a call type, unit type or role to upload an icon for a priority or status. In the Responder, Unit and IC apps, tap the legend button on the map to see the same legend.

data.name: Feature.map-visualizations
data.value: Map visualizations

data.name: FeaturePurpose.map-visualizations
data.value: Heat maps, hexagon grids and overlays of calls, response times, station coverage, unit and personnel responses and movement, from a built-in library or saved by the department.

data.name: FeatureSetup.map-visualizations
data.value: Open Mapping, then Visualizations, pick a library visualization such as Call hot zones, adjust its date range, filters and layers on the Customize tab, and save it. Department admins can share a saved visualization with everyone.

data.name: Feature.road-closures
data.value: Road closures

data.name: FeaturePurpose.road-closures
data.value: Closed and slowed roads and areas drawn on the map, with who closed them, why, a contact and the times they are in effect. Dispatch ranking routes around full closures and slows routes through partial ones.

data.name: FeatureSetup.road-closures
data.value: Open Mapping, then Road Closures, and choose New Closure. Draw the closed road as a line or the area as a shape, choose full or partial, the traffic it stops and its times (use Repeat for a road closed only at night), and save. Set how units travel on each unit type (driving, cycling, on foot or air) so run cards and the nearest units list measure them the way they move.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.PersonnelTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Personnel Turnout Seconds

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.PersonnelTurnoutSeconds
data.value: Seconds a person needs before they are moving; added to their travel time when run card rows that accept people rank them against units. Zero means none.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.WaitingCallAutoDispatch
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Waiting Call Auto Dispatch

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.WaitingCallAutoDispatch
data.value: When a unit becomes available that matches a call awaiting resources, send it to the highest-priority waiting call automatically instead of only alerting dispatchers. Run cards can override this; off by default.

data.name: Field.DispatchRecommendationConfig.WaitingCallMaxResponseSeconds
data.value: Dispatch Recommendation Config / Waiting Call Max Response Seconds

data.name: FieldHelp.DispatchRecommendationConfig.WaitingCallMaxResponseSeconds
data.value: Limit for automatic dispatch to calls awaiting resources: a freed unit whose estimated response is longer than this is alerted, not sent. Zero means no limit; the alert itself always fires.

data.name: Setting.DispatchResponseCodes
data.value: Dispatch Response Codes

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchResponseCodes
data.value: Optional per-unit response codes (for example C3 for lights and siren) that conditional run card rows propose, and whether crews see them on unit pushes and in the field apps. Empty means codes appear nowhere.

data.name: Setting.DispatchRenotifyConfig
data.value: Dispatch Re-notification

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatchRenotifyConfig
data.value: Sends a dispatch again, by push, to personnel and units that have not set a status since it went out: every 5 minutes, up to 3 times. Any status a person or unit sets acknowledges it; automatic statuses do not. Stops when the call closes or the recipient is taken off it. Off by default.

data.name: Field.DepartmentTermOverride.Singular
data.value: Department Term / One Item

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentTermOverride.Singular
data.value: For a module, the department's word for one item, such as Team for Units renamed Teams, used on buttons and headings like New Team; at most 50 characters. Empty works it out from the name. Record types have none.

data.name: Area.incidents
data.value: Incident Back Office

data.name: AreaPurpose.incidents
data.value: Activation, planning, logistics, finance and coordination boards for large or long-running incidents, planned events and exercises.

data.name: AreaValue.incidents
data.value: Run the support side of a large incident from one activation: who is on it, where they sleep and eat, what was ordered and what it cost.

data.name: AreaExample.incidents
data.value: A wildfire activation checks in arriving strike teams, books their lodging and meals, and tracks every purchase against the incident budget.

data.name: ModuleAdoption.incidents
data.value: Requires the Incident Back Office add-on. The finance desks also need Incident Business turned on, and coordination boards need Incident Coordination. Run an exercise activation before the first real incident.

data.name: Ui.AddonRequired.IncidentBackOffice
data.value: Requires Incident Back Office

data.name: Module.IncidentBackOfficeDisabled
data.value: Incident Back Office availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.IncidentBackOfficeDisabled
data.value: Controls availability of the Incident Back Office desks. Disabling this module removes them from navigation and blocks their operations; it does not delete activations or their records. Turning it on still requires the Incident Back Office add-on, rollout and permissions.

data.name: Module.IncidentBusinessDisabled
data.value: Incident finance availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.IncidentBusinessDisabled
data.value: Controls the incident finance desks: procurement, budget, time, cost, claims, recovery, intake and closeout. Disabling it hides those desks and blocks their operations without deleting their records. It only applies while the Incident Back Office is on, and turning it on still requires the Incident Business rollout and permissions.

data.name: Module.IncidentCoordinationDisabled
data.value: Coordination boards availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.IncidentCoordinationDisabled
data.value: Controls coordination boards and the situation desk. Disabling it hides them and blocks their operations without deleting boards or their items. It only applies while the Incident Back Office is on, and turning it on still requires the Incident Coordination rollout and permissions.

data.name: Setting.IncidentBackOfficeDefaults
data.value: Incident Back Office defaults

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentBackOfficeDefaults
data.value: Defaults for new activations: how old an incident command or dispatch source may get before its tiles grey out, the currency and measurement system (blank uses the department's country), the length of an operational period, and whether exercises may notify external participants and vendors.

data.name: Setting.IncidentEnrollmentPolicy
data.value: Incident enrollment policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentEnrollmentPolicy
data.value: How people and units seen on an incident become participants (the enrollment mode), whether people not yet enrolled are counted as a separate band in feeding, sleeping and water forecasts, and how long or old the enrollment queue may get before an alert is raised.

data.name: Setting.IncidentNotificationRouting
data.value: Incident notification routing

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentNotificationRouting
data.value: Which incident positions receive each Incident Back Office notice. Positions are resolved to their current holders when the notice is sent; a notice with no positions configured uses its built-in default positions.

data.name: Setting.IncidentForecastPolicy
data.value: Incident forecast policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentForecastPolicy
data.value: Coefficients and alert windows for logistics forecasts: meal and water contingency, drinking water per person per day, bed reserve, whether predicted timeouts reduce forecasts, replacement lead time, the arrival, timeout and meal cutoff lead windows, and the facility capacity and water days-of-supply thresholds.

data.name: Setting.IncidentAssignmentRulePolicy
data.value: Incident assignment rules

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentAssignmentRulePolicy
data.value: The work/rest rule pack and assignment limits used to flag people who are reaching their limits: maximum assignment days, travel days, maximum extension, maximum work hours per shift and the rest required per hour worked.

data.name: Setting.IncidentVendorPolicy
data.value: Incident vendor policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentVendorPolicy
data.value: How often vendors must be verified again, how long a capacity hold lasts, and how far ahead expiring compliance documents and capacity holds are flagged.

data.name: Setting.IncidentSelfServicePolicy
data.value: Incident self-service policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentSelfServicePolicy
data.value: Self-service links for participants and vendors: how many days a link stays valid after the assignment or engagement ends, whether a one-time code is required before lodging or travel details are shown, and whether vendor links need a verified vendor contact.

data.name: Setting.IncidentFinancePolicy
data.value: Incident finance policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentFinancePolicy
data.value: Finance controls: single-person operation (one person may request, approve, commit, receive and accept only with a recorded acknowledgment), extra sender domains for the intake inbox, the budget, agreement ceiling and daily burn thresholds, intake backlog limits, claim and recovery deadline warnings, the split-purchase window and the micro-purchase threshold.

data.name: Setting.IncidentRetentionPolicy
data.value: Incident retention policy

data.name: SettingHelp.IncidentRetentionPolicy
data.value: How long operational snapshots are kept after an incident closes, how many years ledger entries are kept, and how long expired self-service links are kept. Incident records follow Records retention instead.

data.name: Setting.CoordinationBoardDefaults
data.value: Coordination board defaults

data.name: SettingHelp.CoordinationBoardDefaults
data.value: Defaults for coordination boards: when an item counts as stale, whether road closures and shelter capacity raise alarms, how many days a board share lasts, and how far ahead a due item is flagged.

data.name: FeatureSetup.shift-staffing
data.value: Open Shifts, then Shift Staffing. Pick a day in Staffing by Day, past days included, check the automatic staffing, change the people if needed and choose Approve Staffing. Revert to Automatic drops an approved staffing.

data.name: FeatureSetup.on-shift-hours-report

data.name: Setting.ShiftTradeApprovers
data.value: Shift trade approvers

data.name: SettingHelp.ShiftTradeApprovers

data.name: Setting.DispatcherDeskConfig
data.value: Dispatcher desk

data.name: SettingHelp.DispatcherDeskConfig
data.value: Turns the dispatcher desk on and sets how it works: which work is offered to the dispatchers on duty in the Dispatch app (pending and scheduled calls, texts, phone calls, emails, chats), how long an offer waits and how many items a dispatcher holds before counting as busy, how many missed offers in a row set a dispatcher Away, and what happens to texts and phone calls when nobody is free (wait in the queue, Enhanced AI, or voicemail). It also sets what a call emailed to the dispatch address becomes (dispatched at once, saved as pending, or read by Enhanced AI into a pending call) and the break and duty rules: break reminders, automatic return from breaks, the minimum available, refusing breaks below it, no desk alerts on break, and whether dispatchers must be on a shift or may go on duty without one (Shifts, Dispatcher Desk, Dispatcher Desk Settings). Off by default; emailed calls are dispatched at once until Emailed calls is changed, which applies even while routing is off.

data.name: Feature.home-dashboard
data.value: Customizable home dashboard

data.name: FeaturePurpose.home-dashboard
data.value: A home page of live widgets that each member arranges, saved to their account.

data.name: FeatureValue.home-dashboard
data.value: Members see what needs their attention across every module on one screen, and their layout follows them to any browser.

data.name: FeatureExample.home-dashboard
data.value: Dispatchers open to active calls, unit status and the map; members open to their status, shifts and checklists due.

data.name: FeatureSetup.home-dashboard
data.value: Turn on the new dashboard, then check the default board each role sees before members customize.

data.name: Feature.dashboard-templates
data.value: Dashboard templates

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dashboard-templates
data.value: Department default dashboards for everyone, a personnel role or a group.

data.name: FeatureValue.dashboard-templates
data.value: Members who have not customized start from a board chosen for their job instead of the built-in default.

data.name: FeatureExample.dashboard-templates
data.value: A Dispatcher role template with calls, units and the map, and a department default with status, shifts and checklists.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dashboard-templates
data.value: Create a department default template, then add role or group templates where a job needs a different board.

data.name: Topic.dashboard-customize
data.value: Customizing the home dashboard

data.name: Topic.dashboard-defaults
data.value: Which dashboard a member sees

data.name: Topic.dashboard-addon-widgets
data.value: Add-on widgets and locked cards

data.name: Topic.dashboard-data-protection
data.value: Protected data on the dashboard

data.name: Topic.dashboard-classic
data.value: Turning on the new dashboard and returning to classic

data.name: Setting.MappingNavigationConfig
data.value: Navigation defaults

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingNavigationConfig
data.value: Defaults for turn-by-turn navigation in the Unit app (voice, distance units, arrival radius, the On Scene prompt, roads to avoid) and how late an arrival or how long a stop runs over before a route deviation is recorded.

data.name: Setting.OfflineMapPacksConfig
data.value: Offline maps

data.name: SettingHelp.OfflineMapPacksConfig
data.value: What the apps download for use without a network: the maximum response area (its base map download must fit the size limit), which map data is included, when downloads run, and extra coverage for calls and routes outside the area.

data.name: Module.RecordsDisabled
data.value: Records availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.RecordsDisabled
data.value: Shows or hides Records in the web app's navigation, dashboard widgets and search. Hiding it does not delete data or change permissions. Logs have their own switch.

data.name: Module.ContactsDisabled
data.value: Contacts availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.ContactsDisabled
data.value: Shows or hides Contacts in the web app's navigation, dashboard widgets and search. Hiding it does not delete data or change permissions.

data.name: Module.CertificationsDisabled
data.value: Certifications availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.CertificationsDisabled
data.value: Shows or hides Certifications in the web app's navigation, dashboard widgets and search. Hiding it does not delete data or change permissions. Certification enforcement is not affected.

data.name: Module.DeploymentsDisabled
data.value: Deployments availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.DeploymentsDisabled
data.value: Shows or hides Deployments in the web app's navigation, dashboard widgets and search. Hiding it does not delete data or change permissions.

data.name: Module.ChatDisabled
data.value: Chat availability

data.name: ModuleHelp.ChatDisabled
data.value: Shows or hides Chat in the web app's navigation, dashboard widgets and search. Hiding it does not delete data or change permissions. Chat in the mobile apps is not affected.

data.name: Setting.MappingProviderOverrides
data.value: Your own map providers

data.name: SettingHelp.MappingProviderOverrides
data.value: Department-owned routing, live traffic and address lookup accounts, tried before Resgrid's providers. Only which providers are set is reported, never the keys. Setting all three back to Resgrid default removes the setting.

data.name: Setting.DestinationSuggestions
data.value: Destination suggestions

data.name: SettingHelp.DestinationSuggestions
data.value: Suggests the best destination for a call, and for a unit's status destination, from the department's destination rules (Mapping, Manage POIs, Destination Rules) and the incident location, with drive time and distance. Suggest and fill also fills a new call's empty destination with the best one; dispatchers and crews can still choose another. Off by default, because each suggestion looks up drive times.

data.name: Feature.recurring-calls
data.value: Recurring calls

data.name: FeaturePurpose.recurring-calls
data.value: Calls that repeat on a schedule, such as transfers every Tuesday and Thursday at 08:00, 13:00 and 19:00. Each one becomes a scheduled call ahead of its time and goes out by itself, or a dispatcher is alerted to send it.

data.name: FeatureSetup.recurring-calls
data.value: Open Scheduled Calls and choose Recurring Calls, then New Recurring Call, or press Repeat on a call you already sent. Fill in the call details, facilities and contact, who to dispatch and who to alert, then the schedule, when each call is created and who sends each call. Check the next dispatches and the calendar before you save.

data.name: Feature.call-locations
data.value: Call locations, destinations and routes

data.name: FeaturePurpose.call-locations
data.value: A call's location can be picked from a point of interest, its destination can be a point of interest or a free address, coordinates or what3words, and it can carry a pre-defined route that the unit working it runs in the app, stop by stop.

data.name: FeatureSetup.call-locations
data.value: Add the places you pick up from and deliver to as points of interest, and create active route plans with a start and an end for runs you repeat. On New Call, pick the location's point of interest, the destination and a route; a blank call location takes the route start and a blank destination the route end.

data.name: Feature.poi-capabilities
data.value: POI capabilities

data.name: FeaturePurpose.poi-capabilities
data.value: What your points of interest offer, such as a cath lab, stroke center, helipad or drafting site, ticked on each POI so dispatchers and crews can filter and rank destinations by what the patient or task needs.

data.name: FeatureSetup.poi-capabilities
data.value: Open Mapping, then Manage POIs, and choose POI Capabilities. Add what your destinations offer, then tick them on each POI, or add a Capabilities column to a POI import file.

data.name: Feature.destination-availability
data.value: Destination availability

data.name: FeaturePurpose.destination-availability
data.value: Whether each destination can take patients right now: open, limited, on diversion or closed, with the capabilities it cannot provide, a note and how long the report lasts.

data.name: FeatureSetup.destination-availability
data.value: Open Mapping, then Manage POIs, and choose Destination Availability, or use the Destination availability link under the call form's Destination. Choose Set Availability on a destination when it reports a diversion, a closure or a capability that is down.

data.name: Feature.destination-rules
data.value: Destination rules

data.name: FeaturePurpose.destination-rules
data.value: Rules that choose the destination types and the required and preferred capabilities for a call's type and priority and the travelling unit's type, so Resgrid can suggest the nearest suitable destination with drive time and distance.

data.name: FeatureSetup.destination-rules
data.value: Open Mapping, then Manage POIs, and choose Destination Rules. Add a rule for each case, for example cardiac calls go to a hospital with a cath lab and a water tender goes to a drafting site, check them with Try it, then set Destination suggestions to Suggest destinations or Suggest and fill in the destination.

data.name: Area.dedicated-number
data.value: Private Inbound Dispatch Number

data.name: AreaPurpose.dedicated-number
data.value: Your department's own phone number. Texts to it become pending calls, and with Enhanced AI, callers can report an incident by voice.

data.name: AreaValue.dedicated-number
data.value: Give the public, partner agencies and members one local number to text or call, and every report waits in Pending Calls for a dispatcher instead of on someone's personal phone.

data.name: AreaExample.dedicated-number
data.value: A rural district prints its new local number on its non-emergency reporting flyers, and a text about a tree down across a road arrives as a pending call that a dispatcher checks and sends.

data.name: ModuleAdoption.dedicated-number
data.value: Requires the Private Inbound Dispatch Number add-on, which is sold only with an active paid entity plan. The number only receives texts; replies come from the main Resgrid number. Voice intake also needs the Enhanced AI add-on.

data.name: Ui.AddonRequired.DedicatedNumber
data.value: Requires Private Inbound Dispatch Number

data.name: Feature.dedicated-number
data.value: Department number and intake

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dedicated-number
data.value: Choose and provision your department's number, choose whether texts and voice calls to it create pending calls, and release it when you no longer need it.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dedicated-number
data.value: Once the add-on is active, open the department menu, then Private Inbound Dispatch Number. Search by country, area code or digits, provision the number you want, turn on Create pending calls from texts and save. Then send the number a test text and check Pending Calls.

data.name: Feature.addon-dedicated-number
data.value: Private Inbound Dispatch Number

data.name: FeaturePurpose.addon-dedicated-number
data.value: The Private Inbound Dispatch Number add-on: your department's own phone number for taking calls by text and by voice.

data.name: FeatureValue.addon-dedicated-number
data.value: Members and the public reach your department directly instead of through the shared Resgrid number.

data.name: FeatureExample.addon-dedicated-number
data.value: The managing member buys the add-on on the Private Inbound Dispatch Number page or its billing page, and a department admin then provisions a local number.

data.name: FeatureAdoption.addon-dedicated-number
data.value: Sold only with an active paid entity plan, and bought or cancelled by the managing member. Billed monthly per department, even on an annual plan. When the add-on ends, the number stops taking texts and calls and is released after a grace period unless the add-on is renewed.

data.name: Feature.intake-channels
data.value: Intake channels

data.name: FeaturePurpose.intake-channels
data.value: Turn texts to the department's number, mail to an intake email address, posts in a linked Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord or Google Chat channel, and signed webhook requests into pending calls.

data.name: FeatureValue.intake-channels
data.value: Requests that arrive outside the radio and CAD land in one queue for a dispatcher to review; intake never dispatches anyone by itself.

data.name: FeatureExample.intake-channels
data.value: A hospital transfer desk posts requests in a shared Teams channel, and each post becomes a pending call with the channel's default call type and priority.

data.name: FeatureSetup.intake-channels
data.value: Open the department menu, then Intake Channels, and add a channel for each source. Choose Call template or Enhanced AI processing, limit Allowed senders, set a default priority and call type, then send a test message and check Pending Calls.

data.name: Feature.ai-intake
data.value: Enhanced AI call intake

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-intake
data.value: Enhanced AI reads each message from an intake channel set to Enhanced AI processing and fills in the pending call's type, address, priority and a summary.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-intake
data.value: Dispatchers start from a filled-in call instead of retyping free text. The pending call is saved first, so no message is lost when AI is unavailable.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-intake
data.value: A text saying a car is in the ditch on Route 9 near mile marker 12 becomes a pending vehicle accident call with the location filled in, ready for a dispatcher to check.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-intake
