data.value: Needs the Enhanced AI add-on with AI intake turned on for your department. On Intake Channels, edit a channel and set Processing to Enhanced AI. A dispatcher still reviews every pending call, and departments using Advanced Data Protection are not processed by AI.

data.name: Feature.ai-voice-intake
data.value: Enhanced AI voice intake

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-voice-intake
data.value: Callers to the department's private inbound dispatch number who are not members answer spoken, guided questions, and Enhanced AI turns their answers into a pending call.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-voice-intake
data.value: Take incident reports by phone at any hour without someone answering, while a dispatcher still decides who to send.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-voice-intake
data.value: A caller reports smoke behind a barn, answers the questions about where it is and what they see, and a pending call with the transcript waits for the dispatcher.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-voice-intake
data.value: Needs the Private Inbound Dispatch Number and Enhanced AI add-ons with AI voice intake turned on for your department. On Private Inbound Dispatch Number, turn on Take incident reports by voice and save. Voice calls have a monthly fair-use limit; over it, callers are asked to text the number instead.

data.name: Feature.ai-destination-advice
data.value: Enhanced AI destination advice

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-destination-advice
data.value: Enhanced AI recommends the destination for an open call from its nature, note and call notes and your destinations' capabilities and availability, and suggests a change when the call's details change.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-destination-advice
data.value: Catch a patient who now needs a higher level of care, such as a trauma center, without anyone re-checking every destination by hand.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-destination-advice
data.value: A call note reports a penetrating injury, and the advice on the call suggests the trauma center instead of the nearest hospital, for the dispatcher to apply or dismiss.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-destination-advice
data.value: Needs the Enhanced AI add-on with AI destination advice turned on for your department. Add your destinations with their capabilities and destination rules first. The advice shows on View Call and Update Call, nothing changes until someone applies it, and departments using Advanced Data Protection do not get advice.

data.name: Feature.dispatcher-desk
data.value: Dispatcher Desk

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dispatcher-desk
data.value: A live board of the dispatchers on duty and the work waiting for them. Pending and scheduled calls, texts, phone calls, emails and chats are offered to one free dispatcher at a time, who takes them in the Dispatch app on a phone or tablet.

data.name: FeatureValue.dispatcher-desk
data.value: Work goes to someone who is free: a dispatcher holding work counts as busy, an offer nobody takes moves on to the next dispatcher, and work left waiting alerts everyone on duty. Dispatchers can work the desk from wherever they are, not only from a console.

data.name: FeatureExample.dispatcher-desk
data.value: Two volunteer dispatchers cover a weekend from their phones. A text about a tree down across a road is offered to the one who is free and becomes a call, while the other is on a meal break and gets no desk alerts until they are back.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dispatcher-desk
data.value: Give your dispatchers the Dispatch app login permission and put them on a shift's dispatch roster. Then open Shifts, Dispatcher Desk, Dispatcher Desk Settings, turn on Route work to on-duty dispatchers, choose what to Send to the desk and save. Dispatchers sign in to the desk in the Dispatch app; the Dispatcher Desk page shows who is available, busy or on break and the open queue, and a desk supervisor can end a break or move work to someone else.

data.name: Feature.shift-dispatchers
data.value: Dispatchers on duty

data.name: FeaturePurpose.shift-dispatchers
data.value: Put dispatchers on Assigned and Sign-up shifts, on a dispatch-only shift or beside the responders, with the number of dispatch positions to fill, a minimum on the desk and a desk supervisor.

data.name: FeatureValue.shift-dispatchers
data.value: The desk offers work only to dispatchers who are really on duty: those on the roster of a shift day running now, unless the department allows duty without a shift. Open dispatch positions show on the shift day, and On Duty Now lists the dispatchers with their desk state and breaks.

data.name: FeatureExample.shift-dispatchers
data.value: A dispatch center runs dispatch-only A, B and C shifts with two dispatchers each, and a volunteer department adds one dispatcher position to its weekend sign-up shift.

data.name: FeatureSetup.shift-dispatchers
data.value: Open Shifts, create or edit a shift and turn on This shift takes dispatchers. Set Dispatchers needed and, on an Assigned shift, tick the people on the Dispatch roster and mark a desk supervisor; on a Sign-up shift, dispatchers choose Sign up as dispatcher on the shift day. Only people with the Dispatch app login permission can be added.

data.name: Feature.dispatcher-breaks
data.value: Dispatcher Breaks

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dispatcher-breaks
data.value: Plan breaks and meals for the day's dispatchers on one coverage timeline that shows who is on duty, who is on a break and where coverage would drop below the minimum.

data.name: FeatureValue.dispatcher-breaks
data.value: Breaks stay staggered so the desk is never left empty: Plan breaks spreads a shift's break plan across its dispatchers without overlaps, and the planner warns about overlapping breaks and gaps before they happen. Dispatchers are reminded before each break and, by default, get no desk alerts while on it.

data.name: FeatureExample.dispatcher-breaks
data.value: On a 12-hour shift with three dispatchers, Plan breaks places each one's 30-minute meal and two 15-minute breaks at different times, and each dispatcher is reminded five minutes before a break is due.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dispatcher-breaks
data.value: Set a break plan on each shift, or a default break plan in Dispatcher Desk Settings. Then open Shifts, Dispatcher Desk, Dispatcher Breaks, choose a date and a shift day and use Plan breaks, or plan single breaks yourself. Desk supervisors and shift managers plan anyone's breaks; dispatchers plan their own only on shifts that allow it. A break is a length, so a break started early also ends early.

data.name: Feature.dispatcher-desk-settings
data.value: Dispatcher Desk Settings

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dispatcher-desk-settings
data.value: Turn routing on and choose which work goes to the desk, how long an offer waits, what happens to texts and phone calls when every dispatcher is busy, what an emailed call becomes, and the rules for breaks and duty.

data.name: FeatureValue.dispatcher-desk-settings
data.value: The department decides once how the desk behaves, from how quickly unanswered work moves on to whether a break may leave fewer dispatchers available than the minimum.

data.name: FeatureExample.dispatcher-desk-settings
data.value: A department sends texts and phone calls to the desk, gives each offer 60 seconds, lets Enhanced AI fill in a pending call when nobody is free, and saves emailed calls as pending for a dispatcher to review.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dispatcher-desk-settings
data.value: Department administrators open Shifts, then Dispatcher Desk, Dispatcher Desk Settings. Turn on Route work to on-duty dispatchers, choose Send to the desk, the offer timeout and items per dispatcher, what happens when every dispatcher is busy, Emailed calls and the break rules, then save. The Enhanced AI choices need the Enhanced AI add-on.

data.name: Feature.dispatcher-desk-activity
data.value: Dispatcher Activity

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dispatcher-desk-activity
data.value: Desk activity for up to 92 days: work by kind, completed, overflowed, cancelled and escalated items and the average time to answer, and for each dispatcher the offers accepted, declined and missed, the time to accept and complete, and breaks taken, missed or returned from late.

data.name: FeatureValue.dispatcher-desk-activity
data.value: See whether work is answered quickly, how often it overflows or escalates and whether breaks run on time, then adjust staffing, offer timeouts or break plans from the numbers.

data.name: FeatureExample.dispatcher-desk-activity
data.value: A supervisor sees that texts often escalated on Friday evenings and adds a second dispatcher to that shift.

data.name: FeatureSetup.dispatcher-desk-activity
data.value: Department administrators and desk supervisors open Shifts, then Dispatcher Desk, Dispatcher Activity, choose the From and To dates and select Show.

data.name: Feature.intake-spam-screening
data.value: Intake spam screening

data.name: FeaturePurpose.intake-spam-screening
data.value: Keep spam and robocalls out of Pending Calls: dismiss an intake call as spam and block its sender, limit how many calls one phone number can create in an hour, ask voice callers to press 1 before the questions start, and label messages that Enhanced AI reads as not an incident.

data.name: FeatureValue.intake-spam-screening
data.value: Dispatchers spend their time on real reports. A blocked sender's texts and calls create no calls and get no reply, and a screened call keeps its label in Pending Calls but is not offered on the dispatcher desk; a dispatcher still decides what happens to it.

data.name: FeatureExample.intake-spam-screening
data.value: A marketing number keeps texting the department's number. Past the hourly limit its texts are added to its open call as notes, and a dispatcher dismisses that call as spam and blocks the number for 30 days.

data.name: FeatureSetup.intake-spam-screening
data.value: On a pending intake call, choose Dismiss as spam and keep Also block the sender ticked; the call is cancelled and nobody is notified. Blocked senders are listed on the Intake Channels page, where Unblock lifts a block early. The hourly limit applies to text, voice and WhatsApp channels without allowed senders, never to email, chat or webhook channels.

data.name: Area.relay
data.value: Resgrid Relay

data.name: AreaPurpose.relay
data.value: An open-source companion app that connects CAD and paging email, scanners, two-way radios and LTE push-to-talk radios to Resgrid.

data.name: AreaValue.relay
data.value: Bring calls, messages and radio traffic from the systems you already have into Resgrid without replacing them.

data.name: AreaExample.relay
data.value: The county CAD emails each dispatch to the relay, which creates the call with its run card attached, while a station radio bridged to a voice channel lets app users talk with crews on the radio.

data.name: ModuleAdoption.relay
data.value: Install Relay on a department computer: the Windows desktop app, or headless on Windows, Linux, macOS or Docker. Email dispatch needs no add-on; the radio bridge, recorder and tone-out need the Push-to-Talk add-on and a voice channel. Relay supplements your radio and paging systems; it does not replace them.

data.name: Feature.relay
data.value: Resgrid Relay

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay
data.value: Install and run Relay, choose its modes and connect it to your department.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay
data.value: The Windows desktop app runs several modes side by side with a live dashboard; the headless host runs one mode per process on a server or in Docker.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay
data.value: A department installs the desktop app on its station PC, signs it in with a dedicated member account and turns on Auto-start for email dispatch and the radio bridge.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay
data.value: Add a member account for the relay to sign in as, then install Relay and connect it with that account's refresh token. The radio bridge, recorder and tone-out require this user token; email dispatch and tone detection can also use client credentials. Run Test connection before starting a mode.

data.name: Feature.relay-smtp-dispatch
data.value: Email dispatch through Relay

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-smtp-dispatch
data.value: Relay's built-in mail server turns dispatch email from CAD, alarm panels or paging gateways into Resgrid calls and group messages.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-smtp-dispatch
data.value: Mail to the department dispatch code pages the department, a group's dispatch code dispatches that group and a group's message code sends it a message. Attachments go onto the call, and a redelivered message never creates a second call.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-smtp-dispatch
data.value: The county CAD sends each Station 5 run to that group's dispatch code at the county's dispatch domain, and the relay creates the call with the run card PDF attached.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-smtp-dispatch
data.value: Find the department dispatch address on Call Settings and each group's dispatch and message addresses on Groups. Point your dispatch domains' mail at Relay and list those domains in its SMTP settings. The relay's account needs the Create calls permission, and Add Call Data for attachments.

data.name: Feature.relay-tone-detect
data.value: Paging tones to calls

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-tone-detect
data.value: On Windows, Relay listens to a scanner or radio through a sound card for two-tone and single-tone pages and creates a Resgrid call with the recorded dispatch audio.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-tone-detect
data.value: Members get the page in the Responder app with the dispatcher's audio attached, even when the radio page is the only dispatch.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-tone-detect
data.value: A volunteer company's scanner hears its two-tone page, and the relay creates a call for that station's group with the dispatch audio attached.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-tone-detect
data.value: On Groups, note the dispatch code of each group you tone out: a group watcher dispatches that group, and a department watcher pages everyone. Enter each watcher's tones in Relay. The relay's account needs Create calls and Add Call Data.

data.name: Feature.relay-radio-bridge
data.value: Radio bridge

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-radio-bridge
data.value: On Windows, Relay bridges a cabled two-way radio to a Resgrid push-to-talk channel in both directions.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-radio-bridge
data.value: Crews on the radio and members in the Responder, Unit and Dispatch apps hear each other, and an emergency tone on the radio can create a call.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-radio-bridge
data.value: A SAR team bridges its VHF base radio to the team channel, so searchers with handhelds and searchers with phones talk to each other.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-radio-bridge
data.value: Needs the Push-to-Talk add-on, a voice channel and the relay's refresh token. Key the radio through a CM108 USB or serial PTT interface, set the squelch with Tune and check the wiring and key-up delay with Test transmit.

data.name: Feature.relay-lte-donor-radios
data.value: LTE push-to-talk donor radios

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-lte-donor-radios
data.value: Joins a cellular push-to-talk (PoC) talk group, such as Rapid Radios or Diga-Talk+, to a Resgrid voice channel through one of its radios cabled to the relay.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-lte-donor-radios
data.value: PoC radio users and Resgrid app users share one conversation, although these PoC services offer no API or gateway for outside audio.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-lte-donor-radios
data.value: A security team cables one Diga-Talk+ mobile to the relay, so guards on PoC radios and supervisors in the Resgrid apps hear each other.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-lte-donor-radios
data.value: Apply the radio's profile, key it with a hard PTT line rather than VOX, turn off its own VOX and beeps, and keep it on external power. The donor radio uses one radio on the PoC account and bridges the talk group it is set to. Needs the Push-to-Talk add-on and a voice channel.

data.name: Feature.relay-recorder
data.value: Channel recorder

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-recorder
data.value: Records every transmission on one or all push-to-talk channels as audio files, with a log of who spoke, on which channel, when and for how long.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-recorder
data.value: Keeps voice traffic for compliance and after-action review, on local disk or S3-compatible storage.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-recorder
data.value: An emergency management agency records every channel during a flood exercise and reviews the transmission log at the after-action meeting.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-recorder
data.value: Needs the Push-to-Talk add-on, a voice channel and the relay's refresh token. Each recorded channel occupies a voice seat. Recordings contain operational voice traffic: store, protect and prune them under your records policy.

data.name: Feature.relay-dispatch-tone-out
data.value: Tone-out on push-to-talk

data.name: FeaturePurpose.relay-dispatch-tone-out
data.value: Announces each new Resgrid call on a push-to-talk channel: alert tones, then the call read aloud by Resgrid's text-to-speech.

data.name: FeatureValue.relay-dispatch-tone-out
data.value: Crews who monitor a channel hear dispatches the way they would on the radio, in Resgrid's own wording with your call priority names.

data.name: FeatureExample.relay-dispatch-tone-out
data.value: A plant's emergency response team monitors its channel, and each new call is toned out with a hi-lo alert followed by the call name, nature, address and priority.

data.name: FeatureSetup.relay-dispatch-tone-out
data.value: Needs the Push-to-Talk add-on, a voice channel and the relay's refresh token. Calls already open when the relay starts are not announced, and scheduled calls are announced when they are dispatched.

data.name: Rule.relay-dispatch-code
data.value: No department dispatch email code

data.name: RuleWhy.relay-dispatch-code
data.value: The department has no dispatch email code, so mail to its department dispatch address cannot create a call, whether Resgrid or a relay receives it.

data.name: RuleNext.relay-dispatch-code
data.value: Check the dispatch address on Call Settings. If none is shown, ask Resgrid support, or the administrator of your Resgrid installation, to assign a dispatch code.

data.name: Rule.relay-group-email-codes
data.value: Groups without dispatch or message email codes

data.name: RuleWhy.relay-group-email-codes
data.value: One or more groups have no dispatch or message email code, so mail to those group addresses reaches no one, through Resgrid or a relay. Groups added outside the group editor, for example by an import, can lack codes.

data.name: RuleNext.relay-group-email-codes
data.value: On Groups, find each group whose dispatch or message address has no code before the @, open Edit and save it; saving assigns the missing codes.

data.name: Rule.relay-voice-channel
data.value: Push-to-Talk has no voice channel

data.name: RuleWhy.relay-voice-channel
data.value: The department has Push-to-Talk but no standing voice channel, so the Resgrid apps and a relay's radio bridge, recorder and tone-out have no channel to join.

data.name: RuleNext.relay-voice-channel
data.value: Open Voice channels, create a channel and add the members who use it.

data.name: SetupEvidence.relay-voice
data.value: Push-to-Talk availability and standing voice channels are checked. Resgrid does not observe whether a relay is installed, connected or passing audio; check that on the relay's own dashboard.

data.name: Setting.AllowShiftOverSignup
data.value: Allow Signups Past Group Slots

data.name: SettingHelp.AllowShiftOverSignup
data.value: Let members sign up for a shift group even when every slot its roles offer (required and optional) is taken. They still need one of the group's roles. Supervisors can always assign people past the slots.

data.name: Setting.EmailCallUpdates
data.value: Updates from your CAD

data.name: SettingHelp.EmailCallUpdates
data.value: Update the existing call when your CAD sends a corrected or follow-up email for the same call ID.

data.name: Setting.EmailLabeledFields
data.value: Labels for the Labeled fields format

data.name: SettingHelp.EmailLabeledFields
data.value: Used when your email format is "Labeled fields". Enter the label your CAD writes in front of each value. Separate alternatives with |.

data.name: Feature.protocol-edit
data.value: Edit Protocols

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-edit
data.value: Change a protocol's content, triggers and questions in place; calls keep the text they were dispatched with.

data.name: Feature.protocol-disable
data.value: Disable Protocols

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-disable
data.value: Stop suggesting and attaching a protocol without deleting it.

data.name: Feature.call-protocol-removal
data.value: Remove a Protocol from a Call

data.name: FeaturePurpose.call-protocol-removal
data.value: Take a mis-attached protocol off a call with a reason; the record keeps it, marked removed.

data.name: Setting.ProtocolLibrarySettings
data.value: Protocol Library Settings

data.name: SettingHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings
data.value: Department-wide rules on the Protocols Settings page: whether approvals need a passkey and read-and-sign a step-up, the review interval new protocols start with, and how long superseded and retired versions are kept, with a legal hold that stops any deletion. Missing means the standard signature levels, no default interval and every version kept. Only department administrators can change it.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.RequirePasskeyForApproval
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Require Passkey for Approval

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.RequirePasskeyForApproval
data.value: Approvals and "reviewed, no change" stamps must be signed with a passkey; a step-up by authenticator code or sign-in provider is no longer enough. Approvers without a registered passkey cannot sign until they add one. Off, any fresh step-up or passkey signs.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.ReadAndSignRequiresStepUp
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Read-and-Sign Requires Step-Up

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.ReadAndSignRequiresStepUp
data.value: Read-and-sign acknowledgments will need a fresh step-up instead of the signed-in session alone. Read-and-sign is not available yet; the choice is saved for when it is.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.DefaultReviewIntervalDays
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Default Review Interval Days

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.DefaultReviewIntervalDays
data.value: Days between reviews for new and imported protocols that do not set their own interval, 0 to 3650; 0 sets none. Existing protocols keep theirs. Publishing a version or recording "reviewed, no change" restarts the interval, and the protocol's owner, or the department administrators when it has none, is reminded 30 and 7 days before a review is due and again when it is overdue.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.LegalHold
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Legal Hold

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.LegalHold
data.value: A department-wide legal hold: while it is on, no superseded or retired protocol version is deleted, whatever the retention days. An approver can also hold a single protocol from its edit page.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.Retention
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Retention

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.Retention
data.value: Days each protocol kind (Dispatch, SOG, Clinical Guideline, Policy, Procedure, Reference) keeps a version after it is superseded or retired, up to 36500; after that a background job deletes it. 0 keeps that kind's versions. A version still attached to a call is never deleted, and nothing is deleted while a legal hold is on.

data.name: Field.ProtocolKindRetention.Kind
data.value: Protocol Kind Retention / Kind

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolKindRetention.Kind
data.value: The protocol kind the entry applies to: 0 Dispatch, 1 SOG, 2 Clinical Guideline, 3 Policy, 4 Procedure, 5 Reference. One entry per kind; a kind without an entry keeps every version.

data.name: Field.ProtocolKindRetention.KeepDays
data.value: Protocol Kind Retention / Keep Days

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolKindRetention.KeepDays
data.value: Days after a version of that kind is superseded or retired before it may be deleted, 1 to 36500. An entry of 0 is dropped when saved, so the kind keeps its versions.

data.name: Feature.protocol-review-queue
data.value: Protocol Review Queue

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-review-queue
data.value: Approve or reject submitted protocol versions with a signed approval, then publish them now or on a set date.

data.name: Feature.protocol-review-stamp
data.value: Record a Protocol Review

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-review-stamp
data.value: Mark a published protocol "reviewed, no change" with a signed stamp, without a new version.

data.name: Feature.protocol-compare
data.value: Compare Protocol Versions

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-compare
data.value: See what changed between two versions of a protocol as a redline.

data.name: Feature.protocol-categories
data.value: Protocol Categories

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-categories
data.value: Group the library into categories and set the approval steps each category needs.

data.name: Feature.protocol-settings
data.value: Protocol Settings

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-settings
data.value: Set signature requirements, the default review interval, version retention and the department-wide legal hold.

data.name: Feature.protocol-import
data.value: Import Protocols

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-import
data.value: Bring protocols in from a Resgrid protocol exchange file as drafts for review.

data.name: Setting.TrainingRecordSettings
data.value: Training record settings

data.name: SettingHelp.TrainingRecordSettings
data.value: How training records are kept: rounding of calendar check-in hours, whether members may submit outside training themselves, and the minimum years records are kept after a member leaves.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.HoursRoundingMinutes
data.value: Training record settings / Round check-in hours to

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.HoursRoundingMinutes
data.value: Hours from check-in to check-out on calendar events that count as training are rounded to this step: 5, 6, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or 0 for the exact minute.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.HoursRoundingMode
data.value: Training record settings / Rounding direction

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.HoursRoundingMode
data.value: Whether check-in hours round to the nearest step, down or up. It has no effect while hours are kept to the exact minute.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.MemberSubmissionsDisabled
data.value: Training record settings / Members may not submit outside training

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.MemberSubmissionsDisabled
data.value: When on, members cannot submit outside training themselves. Officers can still record it through an import or a certification credit.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.DefaultRetentionYears
data.value: Training record settings / Keep records after a member leaves (years)

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.DefaultRetentionYears
data.value: Minimum years a former member's training records are kept, used when their category sets none. 0 sets no minimum.

data.name: Feature.training-transcript
data.value: Training Transcript

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-transcript
data.value: Each member's course completions, training records, calendar attendance, imports and outside certificates, with their hours and whether they count.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-transcript
data.value: One record of every member's training and hours for renewals and audits, without adding up sign-in sheets by hand.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-transcript
data.value: Before renewing a certification, a member downloads their transcript as a PDF with hours by category, and the training officer opens the same transcript from the member's name.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-transcript
data.value: Open Trainings and choose My transcript. Officers who review a member's records pick the member on the transcript. Only verified records count toward hours.

data.name: Feature.training-external-submissions
data.value: Outside Training Submissions

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-external-submissions
data.value: Members submit courses they completed outside the department, with hours and evidence (a certificate, photo, document or receipt); a reviewer approves or denies each one in Training reviews, unless the department accepts them as self-reported.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-external-submissions
data.value: Outside courses and continuing education reach the transcript with proof attached, checked by a reviewer when the department wants that.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-external-submissions
data.value: A member finishes an online safety course and submits it with the certificate and 4 hours; the training officer approves it in Training reviews and the hours count.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-external-submissions
data.value: Members choose Submit outside training on their transcript. Reviewers open Training reviews to approve, deny or ask for more information; possible duplicates stay in the records queue. Submissions can be switched off in Training record settings.

data.name: Feature.training-categories
data.value: Training Categories

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-categories
data.value: Group training hours into categories with optional hour targets and retention, start from templates for fire (ISO), EMS (NCCP), workplace safety (OSHA), industry, search and rescue, law enforcement, security, CPD, Canada or the EU, and categorize existing records in bulk.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-categories
data.value: Hours add up the way your regulator, licensing body, insurer or accreditor asks for them, and targets show who is behind.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-categories
data.value: A department applies the ISO template, sets an annual target for company training, then categorizes last year's drill records in bulk by course name.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-categories
data.value: In Trainings, open Training records, then Training categories. Apply a template or add your own, then use Categorize history to give uncategorized records a category.

data.name: Feature.training-credit-mappings
data.value: Certification Credit Mappings

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-credit-mappings
data.value: Count a training category's verified hours toward a certification's renewal, for the whole category or only one part of it.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-credit-mappings
data.value: Renewal hours fill in from the training members already do, instead of being typed onto each certification.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-credit-mappings
data.value: Hours in the EMS continuing education category count toward the EMT certification, so a member's renewal progress moves as soon as a session is verified.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-credit-mappings
data.value: In Trainings, open Training records, then Certification credits, and map a category to a certification type. Records completed before the mapping was turned on become credits only when you apply history.

data.name: Feature.training-history-backfill
data.value: Training History Backfill

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-history-backfill
data.value: Bring training completions and training records from before the transcript onto members' transcripts, with a dry run that counts what would be written.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-history-backfill
data.value: Transcripts start with the history your department already has in Resgrid instead of empty.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-history-backfill
data.value: An officer runs a dry run, sees how many past completions and training records were found, then starts the backfill, which keeps running in the background.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-history-backfill
data.value: In Trainings, open Training records, then History backfill, and run a dry run first. Backfilled records become certification credits only when you apply history to a certification type.

data.name: Feature.training-history-import
data.value: Training History Import

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-history-import
data.value: Import completions from another system with a CSV file: check how each row matched a member, fix the rows that did not match, then import.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-history-import
data.value: Years of records from a spreadsheet or a previous training system reach members' transcripts without retyping.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-history-import
data.value: A department leaving its old records system exports its completions, imports them, and picks the right member for the few rows matched by name only.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-history-import
data.value: In Trainings, open Training records, then Import training history. Download the template, fill in one row per completion with the member, course, date and hours, upload it and review the check before importing.

data.name: Feature.training-hours-report
data.value: Training Hours Report

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-hours-report
data.value: Verified training hours by category, member or month, with CSV and PDF export and former members on request.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-hours-report
data.value: Answer how many hours the department trained, and in what, for budgets, grants and annual reports.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-hours-report
data.value: For the annual report, the chief exports last year's training hours by category as a PDF.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-hours-report
data.value: In Trainings, open Training records, then Training hours. Choose the period and grouping, then export to CSV or PDF.

data.name: Feature.my-courses
data.value: My Courses

data.name: FeaturePurpose.my-courses
data.value: The courses assigned to a member, the courses they can join and the Resgrid Academy lessons, with progress and due dates.

data.name: FeatureValue.my-courses
data.value: Members see what to finish next and pick up where they stopped, on the website or in the mobile app.

data.name: FeatureExample.my-courses
data.value: A new member opens My courses, finishes the Getting started lesson and its short check, and the completion appears on their transcript.

data.name: FeatureSetup.my-courses
data.value: Open Trainings and choose Courses. Assigned courses come first; Resgrid Academy lessons are always there while the Training module is on.

data.name: Feature.academy
data.value: Resgrid Academy

data.name: FeaturePurpose.academy
data.value: Short Resgrid video lessons, each with a three-question check, published by Resgrid for every department at no cost, plus role paths for members, dispatchers, officers and administrators.

data.name: FeatureValue.academy
data.value: New members and officers learn the system the same way, and each finished lesson counts on their transcript under Systems training.

data.name: FeatureExample.academy
data.value: The training officer assigns the Dispatcher path to new dispatch staff and follows which lessons each person has finished.

data.name: FeatureSetup.academy
data.value: Open Trainings and choose Academy. People who can assign training assign a lesson or a role path to members, roles or groups. Lessons for modules or add-ons the department does not use stay hidden.

data.name: Feature.lms-course-builder
data.value: Course Builder

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-course-builder
data.value: Department-built courses with modules, video, documents, protocol lessons, assessments drawn from question banks and surveys, approved and versioned like protocols.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-course-builder
data.value: Run the department's own training online, with scored assessments, seat time and completions that issue or renew certifications.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-course-builder
data.value: The EMS coordinator builds a yearly refresher with a video and a 20-question test drawn from a bank with a pass mark of 80%, then assigns it to every EMT.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-course-builder
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: the course builder is part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-grading
data.value: Assessment Grading

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-grading
data.value: A queue of free-text answers waiting for a grader, and item analysis showing how hard each question is and how well it separates strong and weak results.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-grading
data.value: Written answers get a fair, recorded grade, and weak questions are found and fixed.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-grading
data.value: A training officer grades three short answers on last week's hazmat test; the analysis shows one question nearly everyone misses, so it is rewritten.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-grading
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: grading is part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Area.lms
data.value: Learning Management (LMS)

data.name: AreaPurpose.lms
data.value: Courses, training requirements, classes and formal training reports. Not available yet.

data.name: AreaValue.lms
data.value: Structured courses and formal reports on top of the free training transcript, once released.

data.name: AreaExample.lms
data.value: Nothing to try yet: the learning management add-on is still being built.

data.name: ModuleAdoption.lms
data.value: Nothing to set up yet; the free training transcript works without it.

data.name: Feature.addon-lms
data.value: LMS Add-on

data.name: FeaturePurpose.addon-lms
data.value: The learning management add-on, bought in 25-member packs: courses, formal training reports and verifiable certificates. Offered once Resgrid switches it on for your department.

data.name: FeatureValue.addon-lms
data.value: Adds courses, formal reports and verifiable certificates to the free transcript, for the members you enable.

data.name: FeatureExample.addon-lms
data.value: A department buys 2 packs, enables its 40 career members and runs the ISO FSRS report; its volunteers keep free Training.

data.name: FeatureAdoption.addon-lms
data.value: In Subscription, open the LMS card and choose the number of packs, then enable members on the personnel page.

data.name: Feature.lms-seats
data.value: LMS Seats

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-seats
data.value: Switch the LMS on for members one at a time on their personnel page, or for a whole group at once, within the seats your packs buy.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-seats
data.value: You pay only for the members you train through the LMS; everyone else keeps the free Training module.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-seats
data.value: A combination department enables its 40 career staff for LMS courses and leaves its volunteers on free Training.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-seats
data.value: In Personnel, use LMS seats to enable a group, or open a member and choose Enable LMS. Only active members can hold a seat; add a pack when the seats run out.

data.name: Feature.lms-packs
data.value: LMS Packs

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-packs
data.value: Buy the LMS add-on in 25-member packs and change the number of packs, with the price shown before any change.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-packs
data.value: The bill follows the seats you need: graduated tiers make large rosters cheaper per member, and added packs are prorated.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-packs
data.value: A department with 110 LMS-enabled members holds 5 packs; when it passes 125 it adds a sixth pack and pays the prorated difference at once.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-packs
data.value: In Subscription, open the LMS card, choose the number of packs and check out. Removing packs takes effect at the next billing date.

data.name: Setting.WellnessSettings
data.value: Wellness settings

data.name: SettingHelp.WellnessSettings
data.value: Who reads members' exposure and critical-incident logs (the wellness officer role), who the designated officers and the peer support team are, the certification each wellness role can hold, and how many years entries are kept. Member wellness is part of the Workforce Pro add-on, not the LMS add-on: without it, existing records are read-only.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.WellnessOfficerRoleId
data.value: Wellness settings / Wellness officer role

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.WellnessOfficerRoleId
data.value: Members of this personnel role read every member's exposure log and keep screening flags and follow-ups. Department administrators do not see the logs unless they hold the role. None leaves each log to its member.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.PeerTeamCertificationTypeId
data.value: Wellness settings / Peer support team certification

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.PeerTeamCertificationTypeId
data.value: The peer support team's certification type. With a peer support team role, it is shown as each team member's status; with no role, the members holding a current certification of this type are the team and receive the critical-incident anniversary reminders a member chooses to share. With neither, there is no team.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.RetentionYears
data.value: Wellness settings / Keep entries for (years)

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.RetentionYears
data.value: Years an exposure entry is kept after it happened, from 30 (the OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1020 minimum) to 100. A legal hold keeps entries longer.

data.name: Feature.member-wellness
data.value: My Exposures

data.name: FeaturePurpose.member-wellness
data.value: Each member's own log of carcinogen, bloodborne pathogen, hazardous substance and critical-incident exposures, with entries suggested from dispatch data after a call is flagged.

data.name: FeatureValue.member-wellness
data.value: Exposure records for cancer presumption and workers' compensation, kept 30 years, without anyone but the member and the wellness officers reading them.

data.name: FeatureExample.member-wellness
data.value: After a structure fire, the officer flags the call; each member on scene confirms a suggested carcinogen entry and adds the PPE worn and decontamination done.

data.name: FeatureSetup.member-wellness
data.value: Choose the wellness officer role in Personnel, My exposures, Settings, and optionally a certification type for each wellness role. Members open My exposures from Personnel; officers flag a call from its Wellness follow-up button. Member wellness is part of the Workforce Pro add-on (not the LMS add-on): records are kept for the members with Workforce Pro switched on, and without the add-on existing records are read-only.

data.name: Feature.ai-knowledge
data.value: Knowledge answers

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-knowledge
data.value: Members ask a question and get an answer taken only from your department's published protocols and training and the Resgrid Academy, each part linked to its source.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-knowledge
data.value: Members find what your protocols say in seconds, and the people who write them see the questions the content does not answer.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-knowledge
data.value: A member asks which protective equipment the hazmat guideline requires and gets the answer with a link to that section of the version in force.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-knowledge
data.value: Needs the Enhanced AI add-on with knowledge answers turned on for your department. Publish your protocols and start your trainings; members then use Ask on the protocol library, a protocol, a training or a call. Training officers see unanswered questions under Knowledge gaps.

data.name: Setting.KnowledgeSettings
data.value: Knowledge Settings

data.name: SettingHelp.KnowledgeSettings
data.value: Department-wide rules for knowledge answers on the Knowledge Settings page: whether the Documents module is used, and the department's dosing tool link. Missing means Documents are not used and there is no dosing link. Only department administrators can change it.

data.name: Field.KnowledgeSettings.IncludeDocuments
data.value: Knowledge Settings / Include Documents

data.name: FieldHelp.KnowledgeSettings.IncludeDocuments
data.value: Documents join the sources knowledge answers use. Admins-only documents are used only for administrators, and no document is used while Advanced Data Protection is on. Changing it rebuilds the department's knowledge index in the background.

data.name: Field.KnowledgeSettings.DosingToolUrl
data.value: Knowledge Settings / Dosing Tool Link

data.name: FieldHelp.KnowledgeSettings.DosingToolUrl
data.value: An https link to the department's dosing tool. Answers that quote a dose show it; doses are only ever quoted from a source, and neither the model nor Resgrid calculates one. Anything but an https link is refused.

data.name: Feature.document-sealing
data.value: Sealed documents and Verify a document

data.name: FeaturePurpose.document-sealing
data.value: Certificates, transcripts, protocol PDFs and signed documents are sealed with a timestamp so anyone can check they have not changed; officers can check any PDF under Verify a document.

data.name: FeatureValue.document-sealing
data.value: Hand out documents that outside agencies and courts can trust, and spot altered copies.

data.name: FeatureExample.document-sealing
data.value: An inspector checks that a certificate a member brought from another department was issued by Resgrid and has not been edited.

data.name: FeatureSetup.document-sealing
data.value: Open Verify a document and upload a PDF. Sealing itself is set up by the operator of the installation; until then documents are marked sealing pending.

data.name: Feature.external-signatures
data.value: External signatures

data.name: FeaturePurpose.external-signatures
data.value: Customers, occupants and outside parties sign time reports, bids, contracts, inspections and custody transfers in person on a member's device, or by a Resgrid link with a one-time code.

data.name: FeatureValue.external-signatures
data.value: Replace typed names with signatures the other party can verify, sealed with an audit page.

data.name: FeatureExample.external-signatures
data.value: A crew boss hands the tablet to the customer's representative to sign the daily shift ticket before leaving the incident.

data.name: FeatureSetup.external-signatures
data.value: Open the document and use Hand device to signer, or request a signature by link. For links, an admin adds the department's Documenso team token under E-sign settings; links come with the add-on that owns the document.

data.name: Feature.protocol-acknowledgments
data.value: My Acknowledgments

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-acknowledgments
data.value: Read and sign the protocols and bulletins you are asked to acknowledge.

data.name: Feature.protocol-compliance
data.value: Acknowledgment Compliance

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-compliance
data.value: See who has read and signed each protocol version, by group, and export it.

data.name: Feature.protocol-bulletins
data.value: Priority Bulletins

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-bulletins
data.value: Issue a short must-read notice that takes effect at once and is approved afterwards.

data.name: Feature.protocol-bulk-upload
data.value: Upload Protocol Documents

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-bulk-upload
data.value: Bring PDF and Word protocols in at once as drafts, with their text searchable.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.DefaultContentLocale
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Content Language

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.DefaultContentLocale
data.value: The language protocols are written in. Members whose language has no approved translation of a version read it in this language, and block labels such as Caution are written in it. Blank means English.

data.name: Feature.protocol-block-editor
data.value: Structured Protocol Content

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-block-editor
data.value: Write protocols as blocks: steps, cautions, medical control gates, tables, medications and adult/pediatric variants.

data.name: Feature.protocol-step-through
data.value: Protocol Step-Through on Calls

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-step-through
data.value: Work through a Procedure or Dispatch protocol on a call like a checklist, every step timestamped.

data.name: Feature.protocol-book
data.value: Protocol PDF Book, QR Code and Print View

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-book
data.value: Export a category or the whole library as one PDF book, print a protocol, or post its QR code.

data.name: Feature.protocol-translations
data.value: Protocol Content Translations

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-translations
data.value: Translate a protocol version into members' languages, each translation approved on its own.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.DesignatedOfficerRoleId
data.value: Wellness settings / Designated officer role

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.DesignatedOfficerRoleId
data.value: Members of this personnel role receive bloodborne-pathogen and infectious-disease exposure reports (Ryan White Part G) and run the exposure cases. None means the wellness officer role serves.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.BbpTrainingCertificationTypeId
data.value: Wellness settings / Bloodborne-pathogen training certification

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.BbpTrainingCertificationTypeId
data.value: The certification type of the annual bloodborne-pathogen training (OSHA 1910.1030). Each exposure case shows the member's current status of it. None leaves it untracked.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.MedicalClearanceCertificationTypeId
data.value: Wellness settings / Medical clearance certification

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.MedicalClearanceCertificationTypeId
data.value: The certification type an NFPA 1582 medical evaluation is also recorded as (from the Medical Clearance (NFPA 1582) template). Not cleared suspends it. None keeps clearances in Wellness only.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.InjuryRetentionYears
data.value: Wellness settings / Keep injury records for (years)

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.InjuryRetentionYears
data.value: Years an injury record is kept after the end of its year, from 5 (OSHA 29 CFR 1904.33) to 100. A legal hold keeps records longer.

data.name: Feature.ai-authoring-aids
data.value: Drafting aids

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-authoring-aids
data.value: Draft quiz questions, course outlines and change summaries from the department's own content for authors to review.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-authoring-aids
data.value: Authors start from a grounded draft instead of a blank page, and nothing is saved until they accept it.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-authoring-aids
data.value: A training officer drafts five quiz questions from the new SCBA training and keeps three.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-authoring-aids
data.value: Turn on knowledge answers with Enhanced AI; the aids then appear in the training editor and the course builder.

data.name: Feature.help-search
data.value: Help center search

data.name: FeaturePurpose.help-search
data.value: Free keyword search over the Resgrid Academy and the product reference from the Help menu.

data.name: FeatureValue.help-search
data.value: Members find the lesson or setting they need without leaving Resgrid.

data.name: FeatureExample.help-search
data.value: A new member searches for "status" and opens the orientation lesson.

data.name: FeatureSetup.help-search
data.value: Nothing to set up: open Help, then Search help.

data.name: Feature.academy-guidance
data.value: Guided tours and What's new

data.name: FeaturePurpose.academy-guidance
data.value: First-run tasks for each role built on the Academy walkthroughs, and a short lesson on each release.

data.name: FeatureValue.academy-guidance
data.value: New members and administrators know what to do first, and everyone sees what changed.

data.name: FeatureExample.academy-guidance
data.value: A new dispatcher ticks off opening the call list, checking units and the map.

data.name: FeatureSetup.academy-guidance
data.value: Nothing to set up: each member sees the tour for their role on the dashboard and can hide it.

data.name: Feature.multi-signer-signatures
data.value: Multi-signer signatures

data.name: FeaturePurpose.multi-signer-signatures
data.value: Several people sign one document in order: members at level 1 or 2, witnesses, certifying officials, evaluators and outside parties, with reminders until everyone has signed.

data.name: FeatureValue.multi-signer-signatures
data.value: Sign-offs that need more than one person are recorded in the right order, bound to the exact content, and sealed with an audit page when complete.

data.name: FeatureExample.multi-signer-signatures
data.value: A training officer evaluates a skill at level 2, then the certifying official signs; each is reminded when it is their turn.

data.name: FeatureSetup.multi-signer-signatures
data.value: Members find what is waiting for them under My signatures and on their home page; requests start from the document that needs signing.

data.name: Feature.checklist-witness-signature
data.value: Checklist witness signature

data.name: FeaturePurpose.checklist-witness-signature
data.value: A checklist can require its independent witness to sign at level 2 (a fresh step-up or a passkey) instead of attesting with text alone.

data.name: FeatureValue.checklist-witness-signature
data.value: Controlled-substance and safety checks get a witness signature bound to the recorded results, included with Checklists at no extra cost.

data.name: FeatureExample.checklist-witness-signature
data.value: After a drug box check, a second paramedic signs as witness with their passkey before the check counts as complete.

data.name: FeatureSetup.checklist-witness-signature
data.value: Edit the checklist, turn on the independent witness and the witness signature, and publish the new version.

data.name: Feature.readiness-signatures
data.value: Vendor acceptance and issue receipts

data.name: FeaturePurpose.readiness-signatures
data.value: Vendors accept completed work orders, and members or recipients sign receipts for issued equipment, in person or by a Resgrid link.

data.name: FeatureValue.readiness-signatures
data.value: Replace verbal hand-offs with signed acceptances and receipts that the other party can verify.

data.name: FeatureExample.readiness-signatures
data.value: The pump repair shop's technician signs the completed work order on the station tablet before driving away.

data.name: FeatureSetup.readiness-signatures
data.value: Open a completed work order, or an issued item's Receipt, and request the signature. Remote links need Readiness Pro and the department's e-sign settings.

data.name: Setting.LmsProgramSettings
data.value: Training program settings

data.name: SettingHelp.LmsProgramSettings
data.value: How training requests are approved and in which currency their costs are entered, and whether Records inspections and pre-plan reviews credit building familiarization.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.RequestSupervisorApproval
data.value: Supervisor approves training requests

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.RequestSupervisorApproval
data.value: The admins of the member's group (or the department admins) approve a training request first.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.RequestTrainingOfficerApproval
data.value: Training officer approves training requests

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.RequestTrainingOfficerApproval
data.value: A member who manages training records for the whole department approves the request, after the supervisor when both are on.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.RequestCurrency
data.value: Training currency

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.RequestCurrency
data.value: The three-letter currency code (EUR, CAD, USD …) the department's training request costs, class costs and class fees are entered and totalled in. A class can name its own.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationEnabled
data.value: Credit building familiarization

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationEnabled
data.value: Completed occupancy inspections and pre-plan reviews in Records go on the transcript of the person who did them.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationCategoryId
data.value: Familiarization category

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationCategoryId
data.value: The training category familiarization credit lands in, for example the ISO pre-fire planning category.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationMinutes
data.value: Minutes per visit

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationMinutes
data.value: The minutes credited for a visit that has no start and end time. A visit with its own times is credited its real length.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationFromInspections
data.value: Credit from inspections

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationFromInspections
data.value: Completed occupancy inspections credit the inspector.

data.name: Field.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationFromPreplanReviews
data.value: Credit from pre-plan reviews

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsProgramSettings.FamiliarizationFromPreplanReviews
data.value: Occupancy and contact pre-plan reviews credit the reviewer.

data.name: Feature.lms-training-plan
data.value: Annual Training Plan

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-training-plan
data.value: A year of planned sessions and hours per category and month for the department, a group or a shift, compared with the hours actually recorded.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-training-plan
data.value: The written plan auditors, regulators and accreditors ask for, and a shortfall against the annual targets that shows in June, not at the audit.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-training-plan
data.value: The training officer plans 16 hours of company training each month; by June the forecast shows the department will miss the 192-hour target by 20 hours.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-training-plan
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: the annual plan is part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-competency-frameworks
data.value: Competency Frameworks

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-competency-frameworks
data.value: Job performance requirements, positions and skills, tagged on the courses, trainings and certifications that evidence them, with a gap report per member.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-competency-frameworks
data.value: Shows for every member which requirements have evidence, how old it is, and which have none.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-competency-frameworks
data.value: A department imports its regulator's competency framework, tags its courses, and sees a recruit still has no evidence for three requirements.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-competency-frameworks
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: competency frameworks are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-training-requests
data.value: Training Requests

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-training-requests
data.value: Members ask to attend an outside class with its cost; the supervisor and a training officer approve it, and the class goes on the transcript once taken.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-training-requests
data.value: One approved, costed record per outside class, and spending totals per member, course and year.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-training-requests
data.value: A paramedic asks to attend a 16-hour course costing 450 dollars; the captain and the training officer approve it, and the certificate is verified afterwards.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-training-requests
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: training requests are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-report-catalog
data.value: Training Report Catalog

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-report-catalog
data.value: Every training report in one place, saved with its settings in folders and sent on a daily, weekly or monthly schedule as CSV or PDF.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-report-catalog
data.value: The reports an audit needs arrive by themselves, already filtered the same way every time.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-report-catalog
data.value: The ISO training report goes to the chief and the training officer as a PDF on the first of every month.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-report-catalog
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: saved and scheduled reports are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-certification-cycles
data.value: Certification Cycles

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-certification-cycles
data.value: A certification's next cycle starts by itself once its renewal hours are met, and supervisors, admins or named members are alerted when a cycle completes, starts, nears expiry or expires.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-certification-cycles
data.value: Recurring credentials keep tracking hours without anyone re-entering them, and the right people hear about them in time.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-certification-cycles
data.value: When an EMT reaches the renewal hours, the next two-year cycle starts at the current expiry and the EMS captain gets a note.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-certification-cycles
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: certification cycle rules are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-credential-audiences
data.value: Messages by Certification Status

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-credential-audiences
data.value: Send a message to the members whose certification has expired, expires within a number of days, or who never held it.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-credential-audiences
data.value: Reminders reach exactly the people who need them, without building a list by hand.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-credential-audiences
data.value: The training officer messages everyone whose CPR card expires within 30 days with the date of the next class.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-credential-audiences
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: certification-status audiences are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Setting.LearningRequirementSettings
data.value: Learning requirement settings

data.name: SettingHelp.LearningRequirementSettings
data.value: Training-backed enforcement for the department (off by default), the largest share of a role's members one enforcement run may remove, and the default at-risk warning for new requirements.

data.name: Field.LearningRequirementSettings.EnforcementEnabled
data.value: Learning requirement settings / Training-backed enforcement

data.name: FieldHelp.LearningRequirementSettings.EnforcementEnabled
data.value: When on, a requirement that opts in can expire the certification it backs once a member is overdue past the grace period; the certification module then removes roles after its own grace period. Off by default, never while the LMS add-on is inactive, and turning it on first shows who would lose which role.

data.name: Field.LearningRequirementSettings.MaxRoleRemovalSharePercent
data.value: Learning requirement settings / Largest share of a role removed in one run

data.name: FieldHelp.LearningRequirementSettings.MaxRoleRemovalSharePercent
data.value: A run that would remove more than this percentage of a role's active members is refused, and the department admins are told. Default 20.

data.name: Field.LearningRequirementSettings.DefaultAtRiskDays
data.value: Learning requirement settings / Default at-risk warning

data.name: FieldHelp.LearningRequirementSettings.DefaultAtRiskDays
data.value: Days before the due date a new requirement starts showing members at risk. Default 14.

data.name: Feature.lms-requirements
data.value: Learning Requirements

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-requirements
data.value: Recurring and one-time training requirements by role, group, certification or shift: courses, trainings, hours per category, learning paths and passed skill evaluations, with due dates from when members join or are given a role.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-requirements
data.value: Everyone knows what they owe and by when, and officers see who is at risk before an audit.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-requirements
data.value: Every engineer completes the pump operations course every 12 months, and every member logs 24 hours of company training per calendar year.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-requirements
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs and add a requirement.

data.name: Feature.lms-compliance-matrix
data.value: Compliance Matrix

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-compliance-matrix
data.value: Each member against each requirement: compliant, due later, at risk, overdue, exempt, on leave or not licensed, with CSV and PDF export and a group admin's own group.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-compliance-matrix
data.value: One page answers who is out of compliance and what is due next.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-compliance-matrix
data.value: A captain filters the matrix to their station and exempts a member on military leave.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-compliance-matrix
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs, then Compliance.

data.name: Feature.lms-learning-paths
data.value: Learning Paths and Onboarding

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-learning-paths
data.value: Ordered courses, Academy lessons and trainings with prerequisites and electives; finishing a path can issue a certification. A path per role can be assigned automatically when someone joins or is given the role.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-learning-paths
data.value: New members follow the same onboarding with a due date, without anyone remembering to assign it.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-learning-paths
data.value: New dispatchers get the Dispatcher path with 30 days to finish it, and finishing it issues the department's dispatcher certification.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-learning-paths
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs, then Paths to build a path and Onboarding to assign it by role.

data.name: Feature.ai-call-answers
data.value: Ask about a call

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-call-answers
data.value: Members ask a question on View Call and get an answer taken only from the protocol versions the call cites and its type, priority, determinant and location type, each part linked to its section.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-call-answers
data.value: Crews and dispatchers find what the call's protocols say for this call in seconds, and patient or caller details are never sent.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-call-answers
data.value: On a structure fire at a school, a lieutenant asks where crews stage and gets the answer from the cited section of the school protocol.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-call-answers
data.value: Turn on knowledge answers with Enhanced AI and attach protocols to calls; Ask about this call then appears on View Call's protocols tab.

data.name: Feature.ai-tutor
data.value: Tutor and scenario practice

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-tutor
data.value: Learners ask questions about the course they are taking, and members practise on a short scenario written from a protocol, with their own answers scored against that protocol.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-tutor
data.value: Members check their understanding between drills, and every answer and score points back to the exact section, without anything being recorded on their transcript.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-tutor
data.value: A new EMT practises the cardiac arrest protocol: a short scenario, three questions, and feedback that quotes the steps the protocol lists.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-tutor
data.value: Turn on knowledge answers with Enhanced AI; Practice then appears on each protocol. Ask this course in the course player also needs the LMS add-on.

data.name: Feature.lms-recommendations
data.value: Learning recommendations

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-recommendations
data.value: Recommends learning paths and courses to each member from their open requirements, the paths they are on, their competency gaps and the courses offered to their roles.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-recommendations
data.value: Members see what to take next and why, and officers see the same for the members they supervise.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-recommendations
data.value: A firefighter with no evidence for the ladder competency sees the ladder operations course recommended under My Training, with the reason.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-recommendations
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs, then Recommendations; members also see Recommended on My Training. Explain with AI needs Enhanced AI.

data.name: Feature.approval-chains
data.value: Approval chains

data.name: FeaturePurpose.approval-chains
data.value: Purchases, Incident Action Plans, invoices, Cal OES MARS packages and mutual-aid agreements are approved by a chain of people in order, with amount thresholds, parallel steps, delegates while someone is on leave and escalation when a step stalls.

data.name: FeatureValue.approval-chains
data.value: Every approval is a level 2 signature bound to the exact content: a change voids it, a rejection needs a reason, and the completed chain seals the document.

data.name: FeatureExample.approval-chains
data.value: Purchases over 5,000 need the finance chief after the logistics section chief; if the finance chief does not act within 24 hours, the department admins are asked.

data.name: FeatureSetup.approval-chains
data.value: A department admin defines a chain per kind under Approvals, Chains; members submit from the item's page or Approvals, and approvers find requests under My approvals and on their home page.

data.name: Feature.lms-protocol-learning
data.value: Protocol Quizzes and Micro-Learning

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-protocol-learning
data.value: Make a protocol's acknowledgment wait for a quiz drawn from a question bank, and send members one scenario question a week from chosen protocols.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-protocol-learning
data.value: Members show they understood a protocol, not only that they opened it, and keep it fresh between reviews.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-protocol-learning
data.value: A new mayday procedure needs five questions passed at 80% before the acknowledgment counts, and every Monday each firefighter answers one scenario from it.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-protocol-learning
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: protocol quizzes and micro-learning are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-class-sessions
data.value: Class Sessions

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-class-sessions
data.value: Instructor-led classes on the calendar with capacity, waitlist, enrolment rules, rotating-QR and GPS sign-in, and an instructor sign-off that writes every attendee's training record.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-class-sessions
data.value: One roster per class that stands as the record: who taught, who attended, what was covered and for how long, kept for the category's retention.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-class-sessions
data.value: A bloodborne pathogens refresher for 20 seats fills up; three members wait on the waitlist, and when one withdraws the next is enrolled and notified.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-class-sessions
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: class sessions are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-lesson-plans
data.value: Lesson Plans

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-lesson-plans
data.value: Reusable plans for instructor-led sessions: objectives, competencies covered, materials and props, instructor-to-student ratio, safety plan and pre-brief checklist, versioned and approved before use.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-lesson-plans
data.value: Live-fire, driving and SCBA sessions are taught from an approved plan, and the roster shows which version was used.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-lesson-plans
data.value: The training officer copies the live-fire starter plan, adds the department's burn building and ratios, and a chief approves it before the first evolution.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-lesson-plans
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: lesson plans are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.lms-training-resources
data.value: Facility and Prop Booking

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-training-resources
data.value: The organization's training grounds, classrooms, props, vehicles and equipment, booked for class times so nothing is double-booked.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-training-resources
data.value: Two classes never plan on the same burn building or engine for the same afternoon.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-training-resources
data.value: The ladder evolution books the training tower and Engine 3 for Saturday morning; a second class asking for the tower then is refused.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-training-resources
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: facility booking is part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Field.ProtocolLibrarySettings.ShowDeterminantInDispatch
data.value: Protocol Library Settings / Determinant in dispatch texts

data.name: FieldHelp.ProtocolLibrarySettings.ShowDeterminantInDispatch
data.value: Adds the determinant and the protocol name of a call's case flow to the dispatch push title, the dispatch text message and the voice dispatch prompt. Off by default; with it off every dispatch text is as before.

data.name: Feature.protocol-case-flow
data.value: Protocol case flow (dispatch decision engine)

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-case-flow
data.value: A Dispatch protocol can carry a case flow: entry and key questions, read-aloud instructions and outcomes with a determinant and a suggested priority. Dispatchers walk it on the New Call form, override the determinant only with a reason, text instructions to an SMS caller, and with Enhanced AI get a suggested protocol to confirm. Run cards can react to the determinant.

data.name: Feature.lms-skill-sheets
data.value: Skill Sheets

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-skill-sheets
data.value: Job-performance skill sheets with ordered steps, critical criteria that fail the evaluation, rating scales, timers and evidence, versioned, with a library of Resgrid starters.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-skill-sheets
data.value: Every evaluator grades the same skill the same way, and the department can show exactly what was checked.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-skill-sheets
data.value: The SCBA donning sheet fails anyone who takes longer than 60 seconds or misses the facepiece seal check.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-skill-sheets
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Skills, then Skill sheets, and start from a template.

data.name: Feature.lms-skill-evaluations
data.value: Skill Evaluations

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-skill-evaluations
data.value: Evaluator mode: grade one member or a whole crew on a skill sheet, with Pass All, annotations and evidence, then sign at L2; passed evaluations land on the transcript and the record is sealed.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-skill-evaluations
data.value: Skills checked on the drill ground become signed, sealed proof that requirements and certifications can count.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-skill-evaluations
data.value: A captain grades Engine 2's crew on the hoseline advance on one form, splits out the member who struggled, and signs from a tablet.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-skill-evaluations
data.value: Publish a skill sheet, set who may evaluate on it, then choose Start an evaluation under Trainings, Skills.

data.name: Feature.lms-task-books
data.value: Position Task Books

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-task-books
data.value: Task books on the NWCG model: initiated with a position code and date, tasks signed by qualified evaluators across dates and incidents, recommended by a final evaluator and certified by the certifying official; certification activates the trainee's certification.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-task-books
data.value: Trainee positions move to qualified with a full, signed trail instead of a paper book in a locker.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-task-books
data.value: An FFT2 trainee's task book is initiated in March, two incident tasks are signed on wildfires that summer, and the certifying official certifies it in September.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-task-books
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Skills, then Definitions, start from a task book starter, set who signs and certifies, then initiate books under Task books.

data.name: Setting.LmsSkillSettings
data.value: Skill notice settings

data.name: SettingHelp.LmsSkillSettings
data.value: How skill evaluation and task book notices are delivered, immediately or as a daily or weekly digest, and whether the evaluated members and the department admins receive them.

data.name: Field.LmsSkillSettings.DigestMode
data.value: Skill notice delivery

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsSkillSettings.DigestMode
data.value: Immediately, a daily or weekly digest (one message per person with every notice due), or off.

data.name: Field.LmsSkillSettings.DigestHour
data.value: Skill digest time

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsSkillSettings.DigestHour
data.value: The department-local hour daily and weekly digests are sent.

data.name: Field.LmsSkillSettings.DigestWeekday
data.value: Skill weekly digest day

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsSkillSettings.DigestWeekday
data.value: The weekday weekly digests are sent.

data.name: Field.LmsSkillSettings.NotifyMembers
data.value: Notify evaluated members

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsSkillSettings.NotifyMembers
data.value: The evaluated members and trainees receive notices about their own evaluations and task books.

data.name: Field.LmsSkillSettings.NotifyOfficers
data.value: Notify department admins

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsSkillSettings.NotifyOfficers
data.value: The active department admins receive a notice about every evaluation and task book.

data.name: Permission.ReviewDispatchCases
data.value: Review Dispatch Cases

data.name: PermissionHelp.ReviewDispatchCases
data.value: Allows sampling calls for dispatch case review, scoring the recorded case against a dispatch case rubric, sending the review to the dispatcher and reading the compliance report. Nobody reviews their own calls. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: Feature.dispatch-case-review
data.value: Dispatch Case Review

data.name: FeaturePurpose.dispatch-case-review
data.value: Officers sample calls by protocol, version, determinant, dispatcher and dates, score each recorded case question by question and instruction by instruction with a Records QA rubric beside the protocol's case flow, and send the review to the dispatcher. Reports show compliance by protocol, version, dispatcher and month, with CSV.

data.name: Feature.my-case-reviews
data.value: My Case Reviews

data.name: FeaturePurpose.my-case-reviews
data.value: Dispatchers read the reviews of calls they handled, with every question and instruction scored and the reviewer's comments, acknowledge each one once and may reply once; the reviewer is notified of the reply.

data.name: Setting.LmsCeReportingSettings
data.value: CE reporting settings
