data.name: SettingHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings
data.value: The CAPCE and CE Broker provider numbers, the certification types that hold members' license, NREMT and National EMS ID numbers, and the column lists of the CE / CPD training-hours file and the CAPCE, state CE and state roster files.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.CapceProviderNumber
data.value: CAPCE provider number

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.CapceProviderNumber
data.value: The department's CAPCE provider number when it is a CAPCE-accredited provider. Without it no CAPCE completion file is built.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.CapceProviderName
data.value: CAPCE provider name

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.CapceProviderName
data.value: The provider name as the department enters it on courses and records; completions naming it count as the department's own CE.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.LicenseCertificationTypeId
data.value: State license certification type

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.LicenseCertificationTypeId
data.value: The certification type whose number, area, type and expiry the files report as the member's state license.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.NremtCertificationTypeId
data.value: NREMT certification type

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.NremtCertificationTypeId
data.value: The certification type whose number and expiry the files report as the NREMT number and next re-registration date.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.NemsidCertificationTypeId
data.value: National EMS ID certification type

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.NemsidCertificationTypeId
data.value: The certification type whose number the files report as the member's National EMS ID (NEMSID).

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.CeBrokerProviderNumber
data.value: CE Broker provider number

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.CeBrokerProviderNumber
data.value: The CE Broker provider tracking number (Florida) written in column A of the CE Broker file without its 50- prefix.

data.name: Field.LmsCeReportingSettings.ColumnMaps
data.value: CE file column lists

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeReportingSettings.ColumnMaps
data.value: The department's own column lists, one per file type; a file type without one uses its default columns.

data.name: Field.LmsCeColumnMap.ExporterKey
data.value: CE file type

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeColumnMap.ExporterKey
data.value: Which file a column list belongs to: training-hours, capce, fl-ems, va-ems, nj-ems, fl-fire, state-ce or state-roster.

data.name: Field.LmsCeColumnMap.Columns
data.value: CE file columns

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeColumnMap.Columns
data.value: The columns of the file, in order.

data.name: Field.LmsCeColumn.Header
data.value: CE column heading

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeColumn.Header
data.value: The heading written in the file's header row; files without a header row leave it out.

data.name: Field.LmsCeColumn.Source
data.value: CE column value

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeColumn.Source
data.value: Which value the column carries: a member, record, certification or provider field, or fixed text.

data.name: Field.LmsCeColumn.Argument
data.value: CE column format

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsCeColumn.Argument
data.value: A date or number format for the value, or the text of a fixed-text column.

data.name: Feature.lms-data-export
data.value: Training data export

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-data-export
data.value: Department owners and admins export everything the department put into Training: courses with their versions, lessons and media, question banks with answer keys, and every learning record, attempt and certificate as CSV and xAPI statements, with a SCORM 1.2 package per course where the lessons allow.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-data-export
data.value: A department can always take its training content and evidence with it, also after the LMS add-on lapses.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-data-export
data.value: Before moving to a regional academy's system, the training officer exports everything, loads the xAPI statements into the new record store and keeps the CSV records for the audit.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-data-export
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs, then Data export, pick Everything or Records only and start the export; download the zip when it is ready.

data.name: Feature.lms-ce-reporting
data.value: CE reporting files

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-ce-reporting
data.value: Builds a CE / CPD training-hours file with the columns your regulator or professional body asks for, and for US departments the CAPCE completion file, state CE files (Florida's CE Broker layout and a configurable CSV for other states) and a state-ready roster for systems such as Acadis, with a preview and per-department columns.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-ce-reporting
data.value: Completions reach your regulator, professional body, CAPCE or state office without retyping a roster, and nothing is submitted before someone checks the file.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-ce-reporting
data.value: Each month the EMS coordinator previews last month's CAPCE file, fixes two members missing a state license number and uploads the CSV to CAPCE.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-ce-reporting
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Programs, then CE reporting, enter the provider numbers and the certification types that hold license numbers, then build a file for a date range.

data.name: Feature.protocol-public-pages
data.value: Public Protocol Pages

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-public-pages
data.value: Publish a protocol's version in force, or a category as a set, at an opt-in public address with an embed code. Drafts, audience-restricted and licensed content are never shown, and a page can be revoked at any time.

data.name: Feature.protocol-template-library
data.value: Protocol Template Library

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-template-library
data.value: Clone starter sets written by Resgrid (fire SOGs, search and rescue, industrial hazards, business continuity, law enforcement policies, security post orders, workplace policies and an EMS outline without clinical text) into the library as drafts in your language, with the source, licence and version kept on each version.

data.name: Feature.community-exchange
data.value: Community Exchange

data.name: FeaturePurpose.community-exchange
data.value: Share protocols and trainings with other departments for free. Department data is taken out, licensed content is refused, Resgrid reviews every contribution before it is listed, and other departments can rate, comment on and import a copy with the attribution kept.

data.name: Feature.protocol-open-format
data.value: Protocol Open Format and Export

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-open-format
data.value: Export the library or a category in the documented open JSON format (blocks, version history, decision graph, translations and an attachments list), as one HTML file or as the PDF book. Files in the older format still import.

data.name: Feature.protocol-analytics
data.value: Protocol Analytics

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-analytics
data.value: See how protocols are used on calls by version, the determinant distribution and override rate, time on protocol, acknowledgment compliance and searches that found nothing, with a CSV export.

data.name: Feature.lms-external-learners
data.value: External learners

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-external-learners
data.value: Train people who are not members: mutual-aid partners, contractors, volunteers and the public.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-external-learners
data.value: Partners and the public take your courses and classes without member accounts or access to anything else.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-external-learners
data.value: Contractors take your site safety induction, a neighbouring volunteer company takes your pump operator course, and CERT volunteers register for a class.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-external-learners
data.value: Turn the learner portal on, open courses to external learners, then invite learners by e-mail. Up to 25% of your seats (minimum 25) are included.

data.name: Feature.lms-learner-portal
data.value: Branded learner portal

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-learner-portal
data.value: A sign-in page and catalog for external learners with your department's logo and colour.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-learner-portal
data.value: Learners see your department, not Resgrid, and nothing but their own training.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-learner-portal
data.value: The public finds your CPR classes on your portal and registers after confirming their e-mail.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-learner-portal
data.value: Upload a logo in the department profile, choose an accent colour and decide whether people may register themselves and whether visitors see the listing.

data.name: Feature.lms-public-class-fees
data.value: Paid public classes

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-public-class-fees
data.value: An optional fee per external learner on a class, with a roster export and invoices.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-public-class-fees
data.value: Bill CPR, first-aid and CERT classes: export the roster for your own billing or raise invoices with Business Ops.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-public-class-fees
data.value: A CPR class charges 45 per person; one invoice goes to the employer that sent six staff.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-public-class-fees
data.value: Open a class session's Public class and fees page, list it, set the fee, then export the roster or raise invoices per learner or per sponsoring organization. Resgrid never takes payment.

data.name: Feature.ai-course-drafts
data.value: Course drafts from protocols and SOPs

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-course-drafts
data.value: Draft an online course from a published protocol or an uploaded SOP document: modules, lessons that each cite the sections they teach, and a question bank to review.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-course-drafts
data.value: Training officers start from a complete draft that follows the department's own procedure instead of a blank page, and every lesson shows the source text it rests on.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-course-drafts
data.value: A training officer turns the new mayday SOP into a draft course with four modules and five quiz questions, checks each lesson against its cited section, and submits it for approval.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-course-drafts
data.value: Needs Enhanced AI with knowledge answers and the LMS add-on; open Trainings, Course library, Draft with AI. Drafts are never published on their own, every number must appear in the cited sections, content marked no AI is never sent, and departments using Advanced Data Protection do not get drafts.

data.name: Feature.ai-flashcards
data.value: Course flashcards

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-flashcards
data.value: Practice cards drafted from a course or the protocol it is built from; authors keep the ones they want and learners practise them in the course player.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-flashcards
data.value: Members rehearse the steps and criteria they must remember between drills, and a card is hidden and flagged for review as soon as its source gets a new version.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-flashcards
data.value: After the cardiac arrest protocol moves to a new version, its flashcards disappear from the player until the training officer checks them against the new version.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-flashcards
data.value: Needs Enhanced AI with knowledge answers and the LMS add-on; open a course and choose Flashcards. Practice is never graded or recorded on the transcript.

data.name: Feature.lms-starter-courses
data.value: Starter courses

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-starter-courses
data.value: Courses written by Resgrid (getting started with Resgrid, incident safety basics, a hazardous materials awareness outline, driver basics) to copy into the department as a draft.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-starter-courses
data.value: A department gets a structured first course in minutes and adapts it to its own procedures; the copy keeps its attribution, and partner slots show where accredited content will plug in.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-starter-courses
data.value: A volunteer department copies Getting started with Resgrid, adds its radio channels and station names, and assigns it to every new member after approval.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-starter-courses
data.value: Needs the LMS add-on and Manage Courses; open Trainings, Course library, Starter courses. Starters carry no standard's text and no accreditation.

data.name: Setting.LmsStandardsSettings
data.value: xAPI (LRS) settings

data.name: SettingHelp.LmsStandardsSettings
data.value: Whether LMS course and lesson results are sent as xAPI statements to the department's Learning Record Store, with which key and secret, and whether members are identified by e-mail address.

data.name: Field.LmsStandardsSettings.XapiEnabled
data.value: Send xAPI statements

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsStandardsSettings.XapiEnabled
data.value: Course and lesson results (attempted, completed, passed, failed) are queued and sent to the LRS by the standards worker, with retries.

data.name: Field.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsEndpoint
data.value: LRS endpoint

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsEndpoint
data.value: The https address of the Learning Record Store's xAPI endpoint; statements are posted to its statements resource.

data.name: Field.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsKey
data.value: LRS key

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsKey
data.value: The basic-auth key (user name) the LRS issued.

data.name: Field.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsSecretEncrypted
data.value: LRS secret

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsStandardsSettings.LrsSecretEncrypted
data.value: The basic-auth secret, stored encrypted for the department and never shown again.

data.name: Field.LmsStandardsSettings.ShareEmailInActor
data.value: Identify members by e-mail

data.name: FieldHelp.LmsStandardsSettings.ShareEmailInActor
data.value: Off: each member is a pseudonymous department account. On: the member's e-mail address is sent as the statement's actor.

data.name: Feature.lms-content-standards
data.value: SCORM, cmi5, xAPI and LTI

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-content-standards
data.value: Import SCORM 1.2/2004 and cmi5 packages played in a sandboxed player, launch third-party CE courses over LTI 1.3 with score passback, and send results to an external LRS as xAPI statements.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-content-standards
data.value: Partner and purchased e-learning runs inside Resgrid and lands on the transcript, and results can flow to the department's own LRS.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-content-standards
data.value: A CAPCE provider's cardiac course launches from a course lesson over LTI; the score comes back, the lesson completes and the credit lands on the member's transcript.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-content-standards
data.value: Open Trainings, choose Standards, upload a package or register an LTI tool, then add a SCORM, cmi5 or LTI lesson to a course.

data.name: Feature.ai-protocol-tools
data.value: Protocol practice cards, training and translation drafts

data.name: FeaturePurpose.ai-protocol-tools
data.value: Draft practice cards, a training with a quiz, and translations from a published protocol version for authors to review; members practise the cards on the protocol.

data.name: FeatureValue.ai-protocol-tools
data.value: Protocol authors get drafts grounded in the department's own protocols with Enhanced AI alone, and every drafted item cites the section it comes from.

data.name: FeatureExample.ai-protocol-tools
data.value: After the stroke protocol is published, the EMS coordinator drafts ten practice cards, a training with five quiz questions for the acknowledgment, and a Spanish translation to review.

data.name: FeatureSetup.ai-protocol-tools
data.value: Turn on knowledge answers with Enhanced AI; open a published protocol and choose Practice cards or Draft a training, or open a draft translation and choose Draft translation with AI.

data.name: Permission.RecordTrainingCompletions
data.value: Record Training Completions

data.name: PermissionHelp.RecordTrainingCompletions
data.value: Allows recording that members completed a training or LMS course they took together (from a class roster, or from a course's enrolment list or a training's assignee list with a note). Each record shows it was recorded by an instructor, and the recorder can void it with a reason. Group admins record only for their own group's members. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: Feature.training-record-completions
data.value: Record training completions for members

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-record-completions
data.value: An instructor or training officer records that members completed a training or course they took together.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-record-completions
data.value: Group training (a CPR class, a crew watching the videos together) lands on every member's record, with the certification renewed, and the record says who recorded it.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-record-completions
data.value: After a CPR class, the training captain ticks the attendees on the class roster and records the CPR course as completed for all of them.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-record-completions
data.value: Give the right roles Record Training Completions on the Security page; link the class to its course or training.

data.name: Feature.lms-certification-requirements
data.value: Certification Requirement Sets

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-certification-requirements
data.value: A certification is issued or renewed automatically when a member completes every item of its set inside the cycle: LMS courses, a course set, trainings, a supervised practical recorded by an instructor, skill evaluations or continuing-education hours. Voiding a completion behind it takes the certification back.

data.name: FeatureValue.lms-certification-requirements
data.value: Members and officers see exactly what is left ("3 of 4 done"), nobody re-enters a renewal by hand, and a mistaken completion never leaves a certification standing on nothing.

data.name: FeatureExample.lms-certification-requirements
data.value: An operator certification needs the yearly driving course, the vehicle checks course and a slow speed course an instructor signs off; when the last one is recorded the certification renews to the next 31 December.

data.name: FeatureSetup.lms-certification-requirements
data.value: Nothing to set up yet: certification requirement sets are part of the LMS add-on, which is not available yet.

data.name: Feature.certification-validity-rules
data.value: Certification Validity Rules

data.name: FeaturePurpose.certification-validity-rules
data.value: A certification type expires a number of months after issue, at the end of each calendar year, at the end of the organization's own year, or on a fixed date, with an optional grace period and renewal window.

data.name: FeatureValue.certification-validity-rules
data.value: Annual and fiscal-year authorizations expire the same day for everyone, renewals land in the right year, and dates follow the organization's time zone.

data.name: FeatureExample.certification-validity-rules
data.value: A forklift authorization set to expire on 31 March each year renews to the following 31 March when the refresher is completed in February.

data.name: FeatureSetup.certification-validity-rules
data.value: Open Certifications, then a certification type, and choose how it expires.

data.name: Feature.training-read-and-confirm
data.value: Read and Confirm Trainings

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-read-and-confirm
data.value: A training without a quiz can ask each member to confirm they read and reviewed it before its due date, and repeat every year: an employee handbook, a code of conduct or a site rule.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-read-and-confirm
data.value: Opening a document is no longer counted as reading it: the record shows who confirmed and when, ready for an audit.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-read-and-confirm
data.value: The employee handbook is assigned every January with a 31 January due date; each member ticks "I have read and reviewed this training" and the transcript shows the date.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-read-and-confirm
data.value: Create a training, attach or write the document, tick "Members confirm they have read and reviewed it", set a due date and repeat every 12 months.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.SubmissionReviewMode
data.value: Training record settings / Review of member submissions

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.SubmissionReviewMode
data.value: Whether training hours members submit wait for a reviewer before they count: every submission (the default), none (accepted on submit and shown as self-reported), or only selected categories or above an hours threshold.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewCategoryIds
data.value: Training record settings / Categories that need review

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewCategoryIds
data.value: With review of selected submissions, submissions in these training categories wait for a reviewer.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewAboveHours
data.value: Training record settings / Review submissions above (hours)

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewAboveHours
data.value: With review of selected submissions, submissions of more hours than this wait for a reviewer. 0 means no threshold.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.RoleReviewersOwnGroupOnly
data.value: Training record settings / Role reviewers only for their own group

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.RoleReviewersOwnGroupOnly
data.value: When on, reviewers named by role (Record Training Completions or Assign Training) review only the members of the group they are in. Department admins still review everyone and group admins their own group.

data.name: Field.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewerNotices
data.value: Training record settings / Reviewer notices

data.name: FieldHelp.TrainingRecordSettings.ReviewerNotices
data.value: How reviewers hear about new submissions: a notice for each one (the default), one summary a day, or none (the Training reviews inbox and the home page item only).

data.name: Feature.training-submission-reviews
data.value: Training reviews (members' training hours with evidence)

data.name: FeaturePurpose.training-submission-reviews
data.value: Members record continuing education or training hours done elsewhere with a certificate, photo, document or receipt; reviewers approve them, deny them or ask for more information.

data.name: FeatureValue.training-submission-reviews
data.value: Outside training reaches the transcript with its proof, reviewed when the department wants it, and members are told at every step.

data.name: FeatureExample.training-submission-reviews
data.value: A member uploads a photo of a hazardous materials refresher certificate with 8 hours; the training captain sees it in Training reviews, opens the photo and approves it.

data.name: FeatureSetup.training-submission-reviews
data.value: Choose the review in Training record settings and give training captains and instructors Record Training Completions on the Security page.

data.name: Pack.law-enforcement
data.value: Law enforcement

data.name: PackPurpose.law-enforcement
data.value: Review shift coverage, qualifications, in-service training, policy acknowledgments and record review.

data.name: PackGap.law-enforcement
data.value: The pack can review shift coverage, credentials, training and record review settings. Legal requirements, licensing body rules, use-of-force review and evidence systems are not evaluated. The responsible command or training officer must verify those sources.

data.name: Pack.business
data.value: Business and workplace

data.name: PackPurpose.business
data.value: Review staff groups, qualifications, training, checklists and policy acknowledgments for a workplace.

data.name: PackGap.business
data.value: The pack can review groups, credentials, training, checklists and equipment holds. Employment law, occupational safety rules, insurance and contractor requirements are not evaluated. The responsible manager must verify those sources.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.WellnessOfficerCertificationTypeId
data.value: Wellness settings / Wellness officer certification

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.WellnessOfficerCertificationTypeId
data.value: A certification type of the department, such as one added from the Wellness Officer template, whose requirements and validity the department sets. Each wellness officer's status (current, expiring, expired, missing) shows on the settings page and the member exposure report. It decides who acts only when the certification switch is on. None shows no status.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.DesignatedOfficerCertificationTypeId
data.value: Wellness settings / Designated officer certification

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.DesignatedOfficerCertificationTypeId
data.value: A certification type of the department, such as one added from the Designated Exposure Control Officer template, shown as each designated officer's status. None: while no designated officer role is named, the wellness officer certification serves.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.PeerTeamRoleId
data.value: Wellness settings / Peer support team role

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.PeerTeamRoleId
data.value: Members of this personnel role are the peer support team and receive the critical-incident anniversary reminders a member chooses to share. None: the members holding a current peer support team certification are the team.

data.name: Field.WellnessSettings.RequireCurrentCertification
data.value: Wellness settings / Only members with a current certification act

data.name: FieldHelp.WellnessSettings.RequireCurrentCertification
data.value: Off (the default): the wellness officer, designated officer and peer support roles alone decide who acts, and each linked certification is shown as status. On: a role member also needs a current certification of the role's linked type; a role with no linked type is not affected. It cannot be turned on while nobody in the wellness officer or designated officer role holds a current certification.

data.name: Permission.ManageContentSets
data.value: Manage Content Sets

data.name: PermissionHelp.ManageContentSets
data.value: Allows publishing protocol and course sets to linked departments, subscribing to theirs, deciding the update inbox, customizing the blocks a publisher left open, answering proposals and sponsoring a linked department's LMS seats. Any member can propose a change upstream. With no saved rule only department administrators may.

data.name: Setting.ContentSetSettings
data.value: Set update time

data.name: SettingHelp.ContentSetSettings
data.value: The local time accepted protocol and course set updates go into force on or after their effective date (default 07:00, so nothing changes mid-shift by surprise), and who is told when an update arrives, a proposal is answered, a sponsorship changes or an LTI tool needs registering: the administrators (unless turned off) and members of the roles chosen.

data.name: Feature.protocol-sets
data.value: Protocol Sets

data.name: FeaturePurpose.protocol-sets
data.value: Publish protocols to linked departments as a regional set, or subscribe to a county, medical director or corporate set. Locked content follows the publisher, customizable blocks keep local phone numbers and resources, every new version arrives as a redline in the update inbox and goes into force at your update time, and members propose changes upstream.

data.name: Feature.linked-department-protocols
data.value: Linked Department Protocols

data.name: FeaturePurpose.linked-department-protocols
data.value: Read a mutual-aid partner's published protocols over a Department Link that shares Protocols, read-only and only the version in force. Restricted, licensed and uploaded-document protocols are never shared, and turning the share off cuts access at once.

data.name: Feature.course-sets
data.value: Course Sets

data.name: FeaturePurpose.course-sets
data.value: Publish trainings (and, with the LMS, courses and learning paths) to linked organizations as a set; subscribers receive their own copies, locked or open as the publisher chooses, and each update arrives in their inbox to go into force at their update time. Trainings need no add-on, and quiz changes flow down with each update.

data.name: Feature.lms-sponsorship
data.value: Sponsored LMS Seats

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-sponsorship
data.value: Pay for a linked department's LMS-enabled members from your own packs, optionally up to a seat limit. The sponsored department needs no add-on, may be on the free plan, runs your course sets only and sees who pays; ending the sponsorship or the link lapses access with the usual lapse rules.

data.name: Setting.StepUpPolicy
data.value: Step-Up Verification Policy

data.name: SettingHelp.StepUpPolicy
data.value: Where members must confirm it is them again (signatures, read-and-sign, approvals, protected data), whether it is optional, and whether a password or an identity provider sign-in may be used besides two-factor authentication. Check the members without two-factor authentication the page lists before requiring it.

data.name: Field.DepartmentStepUpPolicy.Areas
data.value: Step-Up Verification Policy / Areas

data.name: FieldHelp.DepartmentStepUpPolicy.Areas
data.value: One entry per area that differs from the default. An area with no entry requires two-factor step-up where it did before.

data.name: Field.StepUpAreaSetting.Area
data.value: Step-Up Area / Area

data.name: FieldHelp.StepUpAreaSetting.Area
data.value: Which actions the entry is for: 1 signatures, 2 read-and-sign acknowledgments, 3 approval decisions, 4 protected data.

data.name: Field.StepUpAreaSetting.Optional
data.value: Step-Up Area / Optional

data.name: FieldHelp.StepUpAreaSetting.Optional
data.value: Step-up is not required for signatures or approval decisions: they are signed with the signed-in session unless the member has verified recently. Read-and-sign uses the protocol library switch and protected data the ADP exemptions instead.

data.name: Field.StepUpAreaSetting.AlternativeMethods
data.value: Step-Up Area / Alternative Methods

data.name: FieldHelp.StepUpAreaSetting.AlternativeMethods
data.value: Kinds of verification accepted besides two-factor authentication: 2 a fresh sign-in with the identity provider, 4 the account password entered again. Neither is a second factor; for protected data only the managing member can change this, and a change ends the grants already issued.

data.name: Feature.lms-course-sets
data.value: LMS Courses And Paths In Sets

data.name: FeaturePurpose.lms-course-sets
data.value: LMS courses and learning paths travel in course sets: hosted video and SCORM or cmi5 packages are shared with the subscriber, an LTI lesson uses the subscriber's own registration with the tool (its managers are told to finish it), and a path points at the subscriber's copies of its courses. Needs the subscriber's LMS add-on or the publisher's sponsorship.

data.name: Feature.deployment-partner-acceptance
data.value: Partner Acceptance Of Deployments

data.name: FeaturePurpose.deployment-partner-acceptance
data.value: When a deployment order is filled for a linked organization on Resgrid, name it as the partner: each fill you accept asks its administrators to accept the assignment with a step-up signature over the link, and the deployment shows who accepted it and when.

data.name: Feature.department-link-acceptance
data.value: Signed Link Acceptance

data.name: FeaturePurpose.department-link-acceptance
data.value: Accepting a link from another organization is a step-up signature by one of your administrators, bound to the two organizations and what each shares at that moment; without the step-up the link stays unaccepted.

data.name: Area.workforce-pro
data.value: Workforce Pro

data.name: AreaPurpose.workforce-pro
data.value: The paid per-member add-on for member wellness and workplace exposure records: exposure log, exposure cases, injuries and medical clearances.

data.name: AreaValue.workforce-pro
data.value: Long-term exposure and injury records for the members who need them, paid per 25-member pack, readable for life even if the add-on ends.

data.name: AreaExample.workforce-pro
data.value: A combination department buys two packs for its 40 career staff, switches Workforce Pro on for them and leaves its volunteers off.

data.name: ModuleAdoption.workforce-pro
data.value: Buy packs on the Workforce Pro add-on page, switch Workforce Pro on for the members whose records you keep, then choose the wellness roles in the wellness settings.

data.name: Feature.addon-workforce-pro
data.value: Workforce Pro Add-on

data.name: FeaturePurpose.addon-workforce-pro
data.value: Buy Workforce Pro in 25-member packs and change the number of packs, with the price shown before any change.

data.name: FeatureValue.addon-workforce-pro
data.value: Graduated tiers make large rosters cheaper per member, there is no setup fee, and added packs are prorated.

data.name: FeatureExample.addon-workforce-pro
data.value: A department with 60 members switched on holds 3 packs; when it reaches 76 it adds a fourth and pays the prorated difference at once.

data.name: FeatureAdoption.addon-workforce-pro
data.value: In Subscription, open the Workforce Pro card, choose the number of packs and check out. Removing packs takes effect at the next billing date.

data.name: Feature.workforce-pro-seats
data.value: Workforce Pro Seats

data.name: FeaturePurpose.workforce-pro-seats
data.value: Switch Workforce Pro on for the members whose wellness and workplace exposure records you keep, within the seats your packs buy.

data.name: FeatureValue.workforce-pro-seats
data.value: You pay only for those members; officers and managers acting on others need their permission, not a seat.

data.name: FeatureExample.workforce-pro-seats
data.value: A combination department switches Workforce Pro on for its 40 career staff and leaves its volunteers off.

data.name: FeatureSetup.workforce-pro-seats
data.value: Open Workforce Pro seats from the Workforce Pro add-on page and switch members on. Switching a member off never deletes a record: their records become read-only.

data.name: Feature.failure-review
data.value: Failure review

data.name: FeaturePurpose.failure-review
data.value: Older checklist failures that were not turned into work orders automatically.

data.name: FeatureValue.failure-review
data.value: Turning on Readiness Pro never floods work orders or takes units out of service for old failures; a manager decides each one.

data.name: FeatureSetup.failure-review
data.value: After turning on Readiness Pro, open Failure review and create or dismiss each older failure.

data.name: Feature.asset-service-setup
data.value: Asset service setup

data.name: FeaturePurpose.asset-service-setup
data.value: Annual, 6-year and hydrostatic service schedules for every extinguisher or other serialized asset of an item at once.

data.name: FeatureValue.asset-service-setup
data.value: Hundreds of extinguishers get their technician service due dates without setting each one up by hand.

data.name: FeatureSetup.asset-service-setup
data.value: Under Preventive maintenance, choose Set up asset service, pick the item and the services its type needs.
